jobs.title: Developer Relations Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Grow the application ecosystem by encouraging and supporting the development and publication of new apps in the app store. Create, maintain, and improve educational resources for app developers, including tutorials, courses, and technical documentation. Review applications developed by commercial partners, provide technical guidance, and help ensure they meet quality expectations. Onboard commercial development partners and support them in building successful product offerings and delivering effective customer support. Represent the project at open-source conferences and community events worldwide by delivering talks, workshops, and technical presentations. Regular international travel is required. Test and review community-developed applications for inclusion in release highlights. Contribute to technical customer support activities as part of the Engineering department. Requirements: Proven hands-on experience developing applications for Nextcloud. Applicants must include a link to code for an app they have developed. Practical technical experience with PHP or Python; experience with both is an advantage. Familiarity with web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus. Experience with one or more frontend frameworks, such as Vue.js, React, Angular, or Svelte, is beneficial. Understanding of containerization technologies, particularly Docker, is an advantage. Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical concepts, teach developers, deliver presentations, and write clear documentation. Public speaking experience is desirable. Applicants are encouraged to include recordings or links to previous talks where available. Knowledge of open-source technologies and communities; previous Developer Relations experience or contributions to other open-source projects are a plus. Strong prioritization and time-management skills, with the ability to deliver effectively within deadlines. A reliable, proactive, and independent working style, combined with the ability to collaborate within a distributed team. Benefits: Competitive salary. Fully remote work within the European Union. Flexible working arrangements that support a healthy work-life balance. 30 days of annual leave. Opportunities for personal growth, learning, and professional development. The chance to contribute to an innovative open-source product used and supported by a global community. A distributed, welcoming team with a strong commitment to open-source collaboration and community engagement.

jobs.title: Group Creative Director
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Define, establish, and maintain creative standards for AI-enabled work across multiple formats, channels, and customer projects. Ensure all creative deliverables align with customer objectives, brand strategies, creative briefs, and broader business outcomes. Provide strategic creative direction, mentorship, and constructive feedback to Creative Directors, Associate Creative Directors, and other team leads. Act as a senior creative representative for enterprise customers, building strong relationships, maintaining trust, and ensuring consistently high-quality creative experiences. Partner closely with the General Manager and Account Director to support customer retention, account expansion, and long-term business growth. Ensure creative leadership contributes directly to customer satisfaction, successful project delivery, and contract renewal outcomes. Help standardise the customer experience across the entire journey, from onboarding and creative strategy through production and ongoing delivery. Identify opportunities to leverage AI-powered creative solutions to generate additional value, improve customer outcomes, and expand creative capabilities. Champion the thoughtful and practical integration of generative AI throughout concept development, creative production, and iterative workflows. Guide creative teams in using AI tools to improve speed, quality, consistency, and scalability without compromising originality or creative craftsmanship. Collaborate with Automation, Web, and AI specialists to align creative vision with technical capabilities, production tools, and operational workflows. Ensure AI-enabled creative processes support repeatable, efficient, and scalable delivery models that meet enterprise-level requirements. Develop leadership capabilities across the organisation, increasing team autonomy and reducing reliance on direct senior-level intervention. Support creative leaders in balancing ambitious creative concepts with operational constraints, delivery expectations, and customer priorities. Foster a culture of accountability, curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement across creative teams. Define and promote a shared vision of creative excellence in an AI-enabled environment. Encourage inclusive leadership, psychological safety, and adaptability during periods of organisational and technological change. Reinforce consistent creative standards, review processes, and delivery expectations across teams. Connect creative strategy with studio-level priorities, operational planning, and performance objectives. Requirements: At least 15 years of professional experience leading creative teams and managing large-scale creative projects. Proven experience operating at Group Creative Director, Executive Creative Director, or an equivalent senior creative leadership level. Strong background in enterprise-level creative delivery across multiple channels, formats, and disciplines. Extensive understanding of modern creative workflows and the practical application of generative AI from initial concept development through final production. Advanced proficiency in generative AI tools and workflows, with the ability to integrate them strategically into creative leadership and production processes. Familiarity with AI platforms such as Krea, Flora, Weavy, Nano Banana, Sora, or comparable generative AI solutions. A strong creative portfolio demonstrating strategic vision, storytelling capabilities, artistic direction, and creative systems thinking. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior decision-makers and communicate creative vision effectively. Previous experience working directly with enterprise customers, senior client stakeholders, and executive leadership. Strong leadership and mentoring abilities, with experience developing creative talent, empowering management teams, and establishing consistent standards across large organ

jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Design, develop, and continuously improve AI-powered developer tools, including MCP servers, intelligent agents, agent skills, and dashboard assistants. Ensure new products and features are accessible to AI agents from launch by developing the necessary tools, skills, integrations, and evaluation frameworks. Explore emerging AI technologies and agent architectures, rapidly prototype new solutions, assess their effectiveness, and collaborate with the team to determine which innovations are suitable for production. Establish and promote an evaluation-first engineering culture by developing evaluation frameworks, instrumentation, and feedback loops to measure AI tool quality and effectiveness. Benchmark AI-powered tools against no-tool baselines, monitor performance, and define quality indicators and release criteria to prevent regressions. Analyse how developers and AI agents interact with existing tools and translate usage insights into improvements to interfaces, documentation, and overall functionality. Design and optimise how technical documentation and product knowledge are structured and exposed to AI agents, measuring their effectiveness and accessibility. Develop reusable patterns and tools that enable customers to integrate AI capabilities into their own applications, including MCP integrations with Edge Functions, vector embeddings, and AI agents running on Edge Functions. Enable cross-functional engineering teams to contribute to AI capabilities by providing clear contribution guidelines, templates, documentation, and review processes. Centralise shared AI logic and reusable components to encourage consistency and reduce duplicated development efforts across teams. Ensure production readiness through comprehensive testing, benchmarking, stress testing, and continuous reliability improvements. Collaborate with AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on service hosting, authentication, scalability, and operational reliability. Work closely with Documentation, CLI, Frontend, SDK, and other engineering teams to deliver a seamless and consistent developer experience. Stay informed about developments in the AI ecosystem and identify opportunities to incorporate relevant technologies and practices into the platform. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional software engineering experience. Strong proficiency in TypeScript and extensive knowledge of the JavaScript ecosystem, including npm, ES modules, bundlers, and compatibility considerations. Deep familiarity with the AI ecosystem, including current tools, agent architectures, development patterns, and their practical trade-offs. Ability to distinguish sustainable and effective AI engineering approaches from short-lived trends or unnecessary complexity. Previous experience building developer tools, product interfaces, or platform components used by other engineers. Experience designing, implementing, or working with evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability, and task success. Understanding of evaluation fundamentals, including baselines, performance variance, cost considerations, and measurable quality improvements. Strong technical judgment when identifying opportunities to use AI effectively while avoiding fragile, unnecessary, or overly complex solutions. Solid testing practices and experience validating software reliability under real-world conditions. Good knowledge of PostgreSQL and relational database principles. Excellent written communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and documentation teams. Comfortable working in asynchronous, globally distributed teams and managing priorities independently. Ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt to rapidly evolving technologies, and deliver high-quality solutions in a fast-paced environment. Additional experience that would be an advantage: Experience working with vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search technologies, particularly pgvec

jobs.title: Staff Reltio Data Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Lead the technical design, architecture, development, and implementation of enterprise Master Data Management solutions using the Reltio Connected Data Platform. Configure, manage, and optimize Reltio data models, entity types, relationships, match and merge rules, survivorship strategies, and data quality rules. Design and implement golden record management and entity resolution capabilities across multiple business data domains. Develop and maintain integrations between Reltio and internal or external enterprise systems using REST APIs and other relevant integration technologies. Architect scalable data ingestion, transformation, and synchronization processes to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability. Establish and maintain effective data governance, data stewardship, data quality, and monitoring frameworks. Troubleshoot complex data management and integration challenges while continuously improving platform performance, scalability, and reliability. Collaborate with business stakeholders, data architects, and engineering teams to translate business needs into effective technical solutions. Define and promote technical standards and best practices for Reltio implementation, data modelling, integrations, testing, and deployment. Lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, and design sessions, providing guidance and recommendations to engineering teams and stakeholders. Mentor and support other engineers, encouraging knowledge sharing, technical development, and continuous improvement. Evaluate emerging technologies and platform capabilities to identify opportunities to enhance the MDM ecosystem and broader data architecture. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline is preferred. At least 10 years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, or data architecture. Extensive hands-on experience with the Reltio Connected Data Platform, including implementation, configuration, customization, and ongoing platform development. Deep understanding of Master Data Management (MDM) principles, including golden records, entity resolution, match and merge processes, survivorship strategies, data domains, and reference data management. Proven experience designing and implementing Reltio data models, entity relationships, business rules, and data quality capabilities. Strong experience integrating Reltio with enterprise applications and data platforms through REST APIs and other integration technologies. Advanced SQL skills and proficiency in Python, Java, or comparable programming languages. Experience working with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Solid understanding of data architecture, data modelling, ETL/ELT processes, and distributed data platforms. Practical experience implementing data governance, data quality management, and data stewardship practices. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and software deployment processes. Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives, influence architectural decisions, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, combined with a strong sense of ownership and technical leadership. Nice to Have: Experience with additional MDM platforms such as Informatica, Profisee, or similar solutions. Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, including Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift. Knowledge of event-driven architectures and real-time data processing technologies such as Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, or Amazon Kinesis. Experience with data governance and cataloguing solutions such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, or Alation. Familiarity with AI/ML solutions, LLM-powered applications, and AI-assisted development tools. Previous experience in commercial real estate, fintech, or business opera

jobs.title: Top talent wanted
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Identify promising opportunities to drive business growth, improve existing operations, or create entirely new revenue streams. Develop and pitch an ambitious, original project with the potential to generate significant business impact. Transform your idea into a tangible prototype, MVP, or creative asset, such as a landing page, product demo, Figma design, or strategic concept. Present your project through a five-minute video pitch, clearly explaining your idea, its purpose, expected impact, development process, and next steps. Explore innovative solutions across Marketing, Product, Technology, Sales, or Operations, depending on your interests and strengths. Take initiative, experiment with new approaches, and demonstrate the ability to turn opportunities into actionable results. Collaborate with high-performing professionals and contribute fresh perspectives, creativity, and entrepreneurial thinking. Requirements: Less than 2–3 years of professional experience, with strong potential and a genuine desire to learn and grow. A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and take action without waiting for instructions. Demonstrated creativity, resourcefulness, and the ability to turn ambitious ideas into tangible projects. A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and willingness to make an impact from day one. Resilience, adaptability, and the ability to learn from challenges and setbacks. Excellent problem-solving skills, curiosity, and a willingness to experiment beyond conventional approaches. Strong communication and presentation skills, particularly the ability to pitch ideas clearly and persuasively. A portfolio of achievements, personal projects, prototypes, or other tangible work demonstrating initiative and potential is an advantage. No specific degree, prestigious academic background, or previous experience at a well-known company is required. Talent, creativity, and execution matter most. Benefits: Competitive, above-market salary package and benefits. Opportunity to work alongside a high-performing team of talented professionals. Direct mentorship and learning opportunities from experienced leaders who have helped scale global startups. Fast-track development program offering an accelerated learning curve and significant professional growth. Real ownership and responsibility from day one, with autonomy to develop and execute your ideas. A dynamic, fast-moving entrepreneurial environment that encourages experimentation, innovation, and bold thinking. Opportunities to explore different business functions and make a measurable contribution to the organization's growth. A culture that values initiative, individuality, ambition, and results over traditional career credentials.

jobs.title: Mid/Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Global talent mapping and sourcing: Identify, map, and engage high-caliber professionals from leading technology companies and major talent hubs across the US, Europe, LATAM, and other international markets. Proactive candidate outreach: Build relationships with passive candidates through personalized communication, networking, and creative sourcing strategies, including niche technical communities and unconventional channels. AI-powered recruitment: Help implement and optimize an AI-first recruitment stack, leveraging AI agents and modern sourcing tools to improve efficiency and candidate discovery. Candidate relationship management: Develop and maintain long-term relationships with prospective candidates to support current and future hiring needs. End-to-end recruitment: Own the candidate journey from the initial discovery conversation through evaluation, interview coordination, and final offer discussions. Candidate experience: Ensure every interaction is professional, transparent, respectful, and engaging, regardless of the hiring outcome. Interviews and assessments: Conduct structured screening interviews to evaluate technical capabilities, experience, motivation, and alignment with the organization's working culture. Hiring manager collaboration: Provide clear, concise, and actionable candidate assessments to hiring managers, founders, and leadership to support informed hiring decisions. jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Wholesale Operations Management: Oversee the complete wholesale and order-capturing lifecycle, ensuring efficient coordination from initial customer inquiries and purchase order processing through invoicing, payment confirmation, and warehouse dispatch. Team Leadership and Development: Manage, mentor, and supervise distributed wholesale and order-capturing teams across different shifts and international time zones. Set daily priorities, allocate responsibilities, conduct regular one-on-one meetings, organize team stand-ups, and support employee onboarding and professional development. Performance Management: Establish and monitor individual and team KPIs, including order accuracy targets above 99%, first-response turnaround times, productivity, attendance, and service-level agreement (SLA) compliance. Identify performance gaps and implement appropriate coaching and workload adjustments. Buyer Relationship Management: Ensure professional, timely, and accurate communication with international B2B retail buyers regarding order status, inventory availability, shipping updates, and account-specific requirements. Handle escalations and resolve complex customer and fulfillment issues. Warehouse and Logistics Coordination: Act as the primary operational contact for global third-party logistics (3PL) providers and warehouse teams. Coordinate inventory allocation, packing, dispatch schedules, and shipment requirements while resolving delivery delays, damaged goods, backorders, and order discrepancies. SOP Development and Process Optimization: Create, document, implement, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) covering order capture, verification, buyer communication, invoicing, warehouse fulfillment, returns, and claims. Ensure consistent adoption of documented processes across the team. Invoicing and Financial Coordination: Supervise the preparation and organization of commercial invoices, credit notes, and packing lists. Monitor incoming payments, reconcile settlements against purchase orders, and collaborate with bookkeeping and accounting teams to resolve billing discrepancies. Operational Reporting and Governance: Audit workflows, identify process bottlenecks, strengthen documentation standards, and introduce improvements that increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Escalate significant financial or operational irregularities to executive leadership. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience in B2B wholesale operations, retail order management, or e-commerce supply chain operations. At least 2–3 years of direct people management experience, including supervising, coaching, and developing remote or geographically distributed teams. Proven experience managing team performance through KPIs, SLAs, productivity monitoring, regular one-on-one meetings, attendance management, and performance improvement initiatives. Strong understanding of end-to-end wholesale order management, including purchase order processing, order verification, inventory coordination, invoicing, payment tracking, and fulfillment. Hands-on experience working with international warehouses, third-party logistics (3PL) providers, and freight forwarders across multiple geographical locations. Solid knowledge of B2B commercial invoicing, payment terms such as Net 30/60, wire transfers, deposits, credit notes, and financial reconciliation processes. Demonstrated ability to create and maintain scalable SOPs, process documentation, workflow maps, and operational systems. Familiarity with modern collaboration and operational tools such as Lark, Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, and ERP/WMS platforms. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to manage international retail relationships and coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams. jobs.title: Influencer and Social Media Lead
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Social Media Strategy: Develop, grow, and optimize organic social media channels, including Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Define channel strategies, content formats, publishing frequency, and community engagement initiatives. Editorial Planning: Create and manage an integrated editorial calendar across all organic channels, overseeing topics, timelines, resources, execution, and priorities. Team and Influencer Management: Lead and develop the Creator and Influencer team by setting objectives, providing feedback, supporting professional growth, and managing capacity. Oversee influencer marketing campaigns from creator selection and briefing to relationship management and performance evaluation. Long-Form and Evergreen Content: Develop and coordinate YouTube videos, blog articles, educational guides, and informative resources. Identify opportunities to transform campaign materials into lasting content assets that generate ongoing visibility and engagement. Public Relations and Earned Media: Build relationships with specialist publications, online magazines, comparison platforms, review websites, and external publishers. Develop partnerships with educational creators, veterinarians, and other credible industry voices to strengthen brand authority and trust. SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Drive organic visibility across traditional search engines and AI-generated search results. Identify relevant content opportunities, address visibility gaps, and translate insights into an effective editorial strategy. Agency and Partner Coordination: Manage external agencies, freelancers, creators, and production partners, ensuring clear briefs, high-quality deliverables, efficient timelines, and responsible budget management. Content Optimization: Monitor content performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and continuously refine formats and distribution strategies to maximize reach, engagement, and long-term discoverability. Requirements: Several years of experience developing and managing short-form, long-form, and evergreen content across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Proven experience managing external content producers, freelancers, creative partners, or agencies. Previous experience in a team leadership role, either through direct management or functional leadership of content creators and social media professionals. Strong SEO expertise, including both content strategy and technical SEO, beyond basic keyword research. Demonstrated understanding of Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI Search, including the factors that influence brand visibility in AI-generated answers. Strong editorial judgment and attention to detail, particularly when creating educational or health-related content. Ability to prioritize credible sources, expert input, accuracy, and transparency. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German, along with good English proficiency. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple channels, campaigns, and stakeholders simultaneously. Creative mindset combined with strategic thinking, ownership, and a results-oriented approach. Genuine enthusiasm for dogs and cats, with an interest in pet health and well-being. Benefits: Fully remote working opportunity, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world. Permanent employment contract. Opportunity to shape and develop the brand’s social media, influencer marketing, and organic content strategy. Leadership responsibility with the opportunity to develop a creative and content-focused team. Exposure to innovative digital marketing practices, including SEO, GEO, and AI-powered search visibility. Opportunity to collaborate with creators, veterinarians, agencies, and industry experts. A chance to contribute to a meaningful mission focused on improving the health and well-being of dogs.

jobs.title: Blockchain Intelligence Analyst, Transnational Crime Organizations
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Produce actionable intelligence on transnational criminal organizations, vendors, facilitators, and laundering pathways, including actor profiles, investigative lead packages, and attribution assessments for law enforcement, executive, and partner audiences. Independently lead complex, end-to-end blockchain investigations, progressing from initial indicators such as wallet addresses, transactions, exchange exposure, and infrastructure leads to high-confidence attribution. Trace illicit funds across multiple blockchains, bridges, mixers, peel chains, and nested services, identifying controllers, counterparties, and cash-out infrastructure such as OTC desks, ATM networks, and cash-to-crypto services. Correlate on-chain activity with OSINT, closed-source intelligence, and off-chain identity and infrastructure signals to establish how criminal organizations operate and move funds. Own investigative workstreams from discovery and validation through to written intelligence production, ensuring all findings are clearly sourced, auditable, defensible, and operationally useful. Build and maintain effective working relationships with law enforcement partners to ensure intelligence reflects investigative needs and supports real-world operations. Strengthen investigative coverage of transnational criminal organizations by developing new attributions, refining analytical methodologies, and improving repeatable workflows. Contribute to briefings, partner engagements, and capability-building sessions, clearly explaining blockchain tracing and attribution techniques. Share expertise with colleagues, help improve team tradecraft, and contribute to a culture of rigorous analysis and continuous learning. jobs.title: Legal Counsel, Global Expansion & Employment
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Legal Counsel, Global Expansion & Employment, you will provide practical legal guidance across international operations, supporting business expansion, corporate structuring, and employment-related matters while ensuring compliance with applicable local regulations. Support international business expansion by coordinating the establishment and incorporation of legal entities in new countries. Advise on a broad range of employment law matters across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring that employment practices comply with local legal requirements. Provide legal guidance and practical solutions to internal departments and business units on matters requiring specialized legal expertise. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including Global Infrastructure, Operations, and other departments, to support strategic business initiatives. Coordinate with external legal advisors, local law firms, and payroll providers across different countries to ensure consistent and compliant operations. Manage legal projects related to international expansion, corporate structuring, and employment compliance from initial assessment through implementation. Identify potential legal and regulatory risks and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies. Draft, review, and negotiate commercial and employment-related agreements in English. Support the development and implementation of consistent legal processes and standards across international markets. Ensure that business activities remain aligned with local employment, corporate, and applicable data protection regulations. Requirements The ideal candidate is a qualified legal professional with experience in employment and corporate law, preferably within an international or cross-border environment. You combine strong legal expertise with commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and a practical, solution-oriented approach to complex business challenges. Law degree and admission to the bar or equivalent professional qualification in your jurisdiction. Relevant professional experience in employment law, ideally covering multiple jurisdictions. Experience in corporate law, particularly international entity establishment, incorporation, or corporate structuring. Opportunities are available across different seniority levels: Junior: 0–2 years of experience. Mid-level: 3–6 years of experience. Senior: 7+ years of experience. Professional experience in a law firm, an in-house legal department, or a startup environment; experience in both private practice and in-house legal work is an advantage. Fluency in written and spoken business and legal English. Strong legal research, analytical, drafting, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical, commercially viable solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across international teams. Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple legal projects independently. Additional assets: Legal education or professional experience in major Asian jurisdictions, such as China, Japan, South Korea, or Singapore. Previous cross-border professional experience or international legal education. Knowledge of data protection regulations, particularly GDPR. Experience drafting and negotiating different types of contracts in English. Additional language skills, particularly Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, French, Italian, or German. Benefits Competitive annual gross salary starting from €40,000, depending on location, skills, and experience. Fully remote working arrangement within a globally distributed team. jobs.title: Office & Event Coordinator:
jobs.description: Accountabilities: In this role, you will coordinate office administration, workplace services, internal communications, and event activities while ensuring a welcoming and efficiently managed working environment. Plan, organize, and coordinate customer events and internal company activities at the office location. Manage general facility and workplace services, including office supplies, refreshments, and visitor access badges. Provide administrative and organizational support for the site's daily operational requirements. Coordinate internal communications by preparing newsletters, announcements, and other employee communications. Maintain and regularly update employee lists, email distribution groups, and internal communication records. Collaborate closely with the administrative team and provide mutual coverage for event organization and internal communication responsibilities. Support and mentor commercial apprentices as a practical workplace trainer, contributing to their professional development and day-to-day learning. Coordinate multiple administrative priorities and ensure that office services and events are delivered efficiently. Requirements The ideal candidate has a solid administrative background, excellent organizational abilities, and a proactive, service-oriented approach. You should be comfortable managing multiple responsibilities, communicating with different stakeholders, and supporting colleagues in a professional environment. Completed commercial or business administration training, or an equivalent qualification supported by relevant professional experience. Several years of experience in administration, office management, secretarial work, or an assistant position. Previous experience as a practical workplace trainer, or strong motivation to take on this responsibility and develop the necessary skills. A practical trainer certification is an advantage. Previous experience organizing events and coordinating administrative processes is desirable. Confident user of Microsoft Office applications. Excellent organizational skills and the ability to work independently, systematically, and reliably. Ability to manage competing priorities and coordinate several tasks simultaneously. Strong customer service orientation and a proactive, solution-focused mindset. Excellent interpersonal, communication, and professional presentation skills. Very good written and spoken German and English. Benefits Fully remote working arrangement. Interim contract opportunity. Opportunity to take on a varied role combining office coordination, event management, and internal communications. Possibility to develop experience in workplace training and mentoring. Collaborative working environment with close interaction across administrative and operational teams. Opportunity to contribute directly to employee experience and the smooth running of workplace operations. Immediate start available.

jobs.title: AI Operations Lead
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As AI Operations Lead, you will own a portfolio of technical operations initiatives, combining independent problem-solving with hands-on implementation to improve internal systems, automate workflows, and ensure sustainable operational improvements. Lead the migration of meeting booking workflows to native HubSpot forms and standardize forms across the website. Design and implement a consistent HubSpot segmentation structure to improve reporting, customer organization, and automated lead routing. Integrate Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and Google Merchant Center with Claude to automate client account analysis, reporting, and alerts. Identify and automate repetitive activities across client account management and sales operations. Improve lead email performance by optimizing engagement, clicks, and response rates rather than focusing solely on sending volume. Standardize and automate content auditing processes to ensure consistent quality and execution across teams. Build automation systems supporting partnership management and joint venture operations. Take ownership of an existing product, overseeing its management, development, and ongoing improvement. Identify operational problems independently, define appropriate solutions, and translate business needs into actionable technical projects. Build, test, debug, and deploy workflows, integrations, and tools using automation platforms, APIs, and AI-assisted development technologies. Document processes, establish clear operating procedures, and ensure newly implemented systems are adopted and maintained over time. Collaborate with sales, account management, operations, and technical teams to implement solutions and drive organizational adoption. Potentially coordinate and support a small team of operations specialists while remaining directly involved in implementation and development. Requirements The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical operations professional who combines strong problem-solving abilities with practical experience building automation systems, managing CRM environments, and deploying AI-powered workflows. You should be comfortable taking ownership of loosely defined challenges, making independent decisions, and delivering solutions that remain effective over time. Proven experience designing, building, and implementing operational systems, automation workflows, or internal tools that are actively used by teams. Strong hands-on expertise with HubSpot, including workflows, integrations, CRM architecture, segmentation, and reporting. Ability to read, understand, modify, and debug code, including through AI-assisted development tools. Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude and Claude Code to build and deploy functional workflows, applications, or automation solutions. Demonstrated ability to identify operational inefficiencies, define solutions independently, and take projects from concept to implementation. Experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier. Familiarity with APIs, integrations, Google Workspace, Google Sheets, and business intelligence or reporting tools such as Looker. Ability to work with tools such as ClickUp and Vercel, or quickly learn comparable technologies. Strong understanding of how to document systems, establish repeatable processes, and ensure long-term adoption by internal teams. Experience troubleshooting complex workflows and identifying issues that may not be immediately visible through standard reporting or system alerts. Excellent analytical thinking, organizational skills, and attention to detail. Ability to work autonomously, prioritize competing initiatives, and make sound decisions with limited information. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with non-technical stakeholders. Previous experience managing or coordinating a small operations team is an advantage. Benefits Competitive monthly compensation of $3,000–$4,500 USD, dependin

jobs.title: Associate - Global Organized Crime Index
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As an Associate, you will support the different stages of the Global Organized Crime Index's production, working closely with the research coordination team and contributing to research, expert engagement, project coordination, and dissemination activities. Identify and engage experts in organized crime to support the development and dissemination of the Global Organized Crime Index. Participate in regular virtual meetings, providing progress updates and relevant information to the Research Coordinator and Project Lead. Coordinate and organize expert group meetings, workshops, virtual meetings, and other project-related events. Contribute to drafting, reviewing, and updating documentation related to the Index. Conduct country-specific and thematic research on organized crime trends, events, and developments. Regularly update country profiles covering criminal markets, organized crime actors, and national resilience mechanisms across assigned regions. Consolidate research findings and expert feedback into comprehensive profiles prepared for expert review. Support communication and dissemination activities to increase the visibility and reach of the Index. Assist with administrative duties and other project-related tasks as required. Requirements The ideal candidate has an academic background in criminology, organized crime, or a related social science discipline, combined with strong research, analytical, and organizational capabilities. You should be comfortable working independently and collaboratively in an international environment while maintaining accuracy and meeting demanding deadlines. Undergraduate degree in Organized Crime or a related social science discipline, such as Criminology, Security Studies, Law, International Relations, or International Crime and Justice. Strong research experience, particularly in conducting structured research and gathering reliable information. Fluency in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Strong organizational and time-management skills. Exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy when handling large amounts of information. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a small team. Capacity to manage multiple responsibilities systematically and meet strict deadlines, including under pressure. Additional assets: Previous experience working in a field related to organized crime. Experience in data collection, statistical analysis, or research methodologies. Benefits Opportunity to contribute to a major international research initiative addressing transnational organized crime. Exposure to a global network of researchers, specialists, and experts working across different regions. Opportunity to develop expertise in organized crime, criminal markets, governance, and national resilience. Fully remote working arrangement. Full-time, six-month contract. Opportunity to collaborate with a globally distributed and multidisciplinary research team.

jobs.title: Product Lead, Self-Serve Growth
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As the Product Lead, Self-Serve Growth, you will own the self-serve growth strategy and continuously improve the digital experiences, product journeys, and conversion mechanisms that drive customer acquisition and long-term business performance. Own and optimize the complete self-serve funnel, including signup, trial, activation, paid conversion, and customer expansion. Lead the product roadmap for the website and application interface, defining priorities and collaborating with engineering leads, developers, and designers to deliver impactful improvements. Turn the website into an effective customer acquisition and conversion channel by optimizing user experiences, messaging, content formats, and product narratives. Design and implement product-led growth journeys across developer ecosystems, open-source communities, and emerging AI agent platforms. Improve developer onboarding experiences by optimizing documentation, SDKs, code examples, and initial product interactions. Develop customer data strategies using product usage signals and firmographic information to deliver personalized onboarding, relevant content, and targeted nurturing campaigns. Partner with Revenue Operations to identify high-potential customers and determine when sales teams should engage with qualified prospects. Establish a structured experimentation framework by developing hypotheses, running A/B tests, analyzing funnel performance, and scaling successful initiatives. Collaborate cross-functionally with product marketing, engineering, design, customer success, RevOps, and sales to align growth initiatives. Monitor key performance indicators, including signup-to-activation rates, trial-to-paid conversion, self-serve revenue, expansion revenue, funnel velocity, and the quality of product-qualified leads. Requirements The ideal candidate is an experienced growth product professional with a strong understanding of B2B SaaS, developer-focused products, and product-led growth strategies. You combine analytical thinking, technical curiosity, experimentation skills, and the ability to turn customer insights into measurable business results. 5–8+ years of experience in growth, growth product management, lifecycle marketing, or funnel optimization roles. Proven success driving customer acquisition and managing growth funnels in B2B SaaS or developer-focused businesses with self-serve or product-led growth models. Experience working with developer tools, APIs, data products, or other technical audiences. Deep understanding of how engineers discover, evaluate, adopt, and integrate technical products. Demonstrated ability to build high-performing websites that generate demand and drive conversions, with direct ownership of conversion outcomes rather than traffic alone. Track record of improving customer activation, free-to-paid conversion, revenue expansion, and churn reduction. Strong analytical capabilities, including defining performance metrics, instrumenting funnels, segmenting customers, and combining product usage data with marketing and sales insights. Experience as a product owner or growth product manager, working closely with engineering and design teams to define requirements, prioritize initiatives, and deliver iterative improvements. Practical experience using AI-powered coding tools to prototype experiments, create mockups, and build functional demos independently. Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to align product, marketing, customer success, Revenue Operations, and sales teams around shared growth objectives. Nice to have: Experience writing production code or contributing to open-source projects. Familiarity with experimentation platforms and product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Google Analytics 4. Knowledge of marketing automation platforms and CRM systems. Experience developing product-qualified lead (PQL) strategies or platform-to-enterprise upgrade journeys. Benefits Opportun

jobs.title: Sr Regulatory CMC Consultant - Small Molecule & Veeva RIM Must Have
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will provide senior-level regulatory CMC expertise, supporting the maintenance and regulatory oversight of pharmaceutical products while ensuring activities align with applicable North American requirements. Your responsibilities will include: Support regulatory affairs activities for small-molecule pharmaceutical products, with a focus on Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) requirements. Apply knowledge of the North American regulatory framework to support product compliance and lifecycle activities. Contribute to processes for maintaining products on the market, including regulatory reporting and ongoing surveillance. Interpret and assess relevant regulatory guidelines and requirements, translating them into practical recommendations. Apply an understanding of drug development principles and related regulatory concepts to assigned projects. Collaborate with internal teams and stakeholders to address regulatory questions and support project deliverables. Plan, prioritize, and organize work efficiently to meet project objectives and deadlines. Communicate regulatory information, findings, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines extensive pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry experience with strong knowledge of regulatory affairs and the ability to work effectively in a consulting environment. jobs.title: Senior Engineer - IT and Workplace Technology
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: You will oversee core IT and identity operations while leading technical improvements that reduce manual work, strengthen access management, and improve the employee experience. Your main responsibilities will include: Manage the IAM, IT, and Workplace Technology request queue alongside the team, ensuring high standards of service quality and turnaround times. Own and deliver the technical roadmap, prioritizing initiatives such as SCIM-based day-one provisioning, Okta improvements, automated access reviews, and device enrollment. Automate repetitive IT and access management tasks using identity platforms, scripting, workflow automation, APIs, and AI tools. Manage joiner, mover, and leaver processes to ensure employees receive appropriate access when they join or change roles and that access is promptly revoked when they leave. Maintain audit-ready access controls and collaborate with Security and Governance, Risk, and Compliance teams on least-privilege practices, access reviews, and evidence collection for PCI DSS and SOC 2. Partner with Security Engineering on privileged access decisions, policy exceptions, and other matters requiring specialist security input. Mentor fellow engineers, review their work, and support their professional development. Monitor and report on operational performance, including request volumes, resolution times, and the impact of automation. Requirements: The ideal candidate brings strong technical experience across corporate IT, identity management, and workplace engineering, combined with the ability to take ownership of projects and improve processes in a changing environment. The key requirements include: Senior-level experience in IT, IAM, or corporate engineering, preferably within a fast-growing technology company. Hands-on experience with an identity provider such as Okta, Entra ID, or Google Workspace, including SSO, SCIM, and identity lifecycle management. Proven ability to automate manual IT and access management processes using scripting, workflow automation tools, or APIs. Experience administering SaaS applications and managing endpoints through platforms such as Jamf, Kandji, or Intune. Strong understanding of access control principles, particularly least privilege, and the judgment to identify when security escalation is required. Experience managing technical projects from initial planning through implementation and delivery. Ability to mentor colleagues, provide constructive technical feedback, and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture. Clear, friendly, and effective written communication skills, with the ability to support colleagues across different business functions. Nice to have: Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated industry. Familiarity with compliance frameworks and standards such as PCI DSS, SOC 2, and ISO 27001. Experience conducting access reviews and preparing audit evidence. Experience using AI tools to improve IT support and operational efficiency. Experience scaling IT operations during a period of rapid organizational growth. Benefits: Fully remote work within a globally distributed organization. Competitive share options. Flexible annual leave, with a minimum of 25 days to be taken. Access to co-working spaces across major cities. Opportunities to participate in workations and an annual company retreat. High-quality equipment tailored to the role. £500 contribution toward home office setup. Generous learning and professional development budget. Private medical insurance. Additional location-dependent perks and benefits.

jobs.title: Senior M&A Finance Integration Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: In this role, you will take ownership of finance integration activities throughout the M&A lifecycle, ensuring operational continuity, financial accuracy, and compliance with relevant accounting standards. Your main responsibilities will include: Lead end-to-end Record-to-Report (R2R) integration activities related to mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and organizational changes. Define and implement finance integration strategies, roadmaps, and standardized processes to ensure successful transitions. Drive Day 1 readiness assessments, covering accounting requirements, financial reporting, internal controls, master data, and potential integration risks. Manage post-acquisition integration activities, including ERP harmonization, data migration, financial reconciliations, process optimization, and operational stabilization. Provide subject matter expertise in general ledger accounting, financial closing, consolidation, intercompany processes, and financial reporting. Establish integration governance frameworks, monitor project milestones, and ensure compliance with accounting standards and internal control requirements. Identify integration challenges and develop solutions to ensure continuity and efficiency across financial operations. Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, IT, Tax, Treasury, and M&A stakeholders to maintain alignment and ensure successful project delivery. Support the transition toward standardized and scalable finance operating models across international business units. Requirements : The ideal candidate brings extensive experience in finance transformation and M&A integration, with strong technical accounting knowledge and the ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives. The following qualifications and competencies are required: Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Professional qualifications such as CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or ACA are highly advantageous. At least 10 years of professional experience in Finance, Accounting, Record-to-Report (R2R), or Finance Transformation within an international environment. Proven experience leading finance integration initiatives involving mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, or carve-outs, including Day 1 readiness and post-merger integration. Strong expertise in IFRS, general ledger accounting, financial closing, consolidation, intercompany accounting, and internal controls. Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP Central Finance, SAP Group Reporting, or comparable ERP and financial consolidation systems. Strong project management skills, with the ability to coordinate complex integration programs and manage multiple priorities. Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, including the ability to influence and collaborate with senior leadership. Analytical, structured, and solution-oriented mindset, with strong problem-solving capabilities. Fluent written and spoken English. Benefits : Fully remote working arrangement, with worldwide location flexibility. Freelance or self-employed contract arrangement. Opportunity to lead strategic finance integration initiatives across international M&A projects. Exposure to complex finance transformation, ERP harmonization, and organizational integration activities. Collaboration with senior stakeholders and multidisciplinary international teams. Opportunity to leverage and further develop expertise in financial transformation and M&A integration. Expected start date: As soon as possible.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Integrations
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: In this role, you will build and maintain developer-focused integrations that make web data services accessible through AI coding agents, frameworks, cloud platforms, and automation ecosystems. Your main responsibilities will include: Develop and publish integrations that connect web data services with coding-agent environments such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Docker, building on existing MCP infrastructure. Design, develop, and release a shared command-line interface (CLI), publishing packages through PyPI and npm. Build and maintain packages, tools, and connectors for developer frameworks and agent SDKs, including LangChain and LlamaIndex, as well as browser automation tools. Implement recurring data delivery solutions for customer cloud and data platforms, including AWS, Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery, and Snowflake, leveraging existing export capabilities where possible. Evaluate application-building and automation platforms such as Dify, Flowise, Make, Zapier, Lovable, and Replit, developing prototypes and templates where they can generate sustained product adoption. Assess potential integrations by estimating technical feasibility, development effort, dependencies, and long-term maintenance requirements. Implement tracking mechanisms to measure signups and usage attributable to individual integrations, identifying any gaps in attribution. Create clear setup guides, technical documentation, and practical examples for developers and AI coding agents across public repositories and documentation platforms. Manage submissions to partner directories, registries, and marketplaces, including addressing technical feedback and review requirements. Maintain and improve existing integrations by monitoring partner tool updates, resolving issues, and managing releases and versioning. Collaborate with Product, Product Marketing, and Developer Relations teams on product launches, positioning, and developer community engagement. Work with SaaS and Platform engineering teams to ensure the stability and reliability of the underlying API and cloud infrastructure. Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and regular team activities within an agile, cross-functional environment. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering expertise with practical experience building developer tools, integrations, and AI-powered workflows. You should be comfortable working independently, navigating evolving technical requirements, and delivering solutions that drive measurable developer adoption. The following qualifications and skills are expected: Strong programming skills in Python, with solid experience in TypeScript and Node.js. Proven experience developing SDKs, client libraries, command-line interfaces, plugins, or third-party integrations used by external developers. Hands-on experience with AI coding agents and development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool-calling interfaces. Experience publishing and maintaining software packages through PyPI and npm, including version management, CI/CD pipelines, testing, and release processes. Good understanding of REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, and secure credential management across client-side and server-side environments. Strong outcome-oriented mindset, with a focus on developer adoption, product usage, and continuous improvement through data-driven decisions. Excellent written English skills, particularly for producing technical documentation, setup instructions, and practical code examples. Ability to work effectively with ambiguity, independently assess technical challenges, and scope projects in an evolving team environment. Additional Qualifications (Preferred): Experience working in a distributed, remote-first international team. Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other AI agent development frameworks and SDKs. Experience with AWS or Google Cloud data se

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Consultant
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: In this role, you will take direct ownership of security improvements, combining technical implementation, governance, compliance, and team enablement. Your main responsibilities will include: Security assessment and governance: Conduct security maturity assessments using frameworks such as OWASP SAMM, reviewing repositories, development pipelines, and cloud environments. Translate assessment findings into prioritized security roadmaps. Develop and maintain security policies and procedures covering access control, acceptable use, secure development, incident response, vendor management, and AI tool usage. Maintain security backlogs, risk registers, and performance metrics, providing monthly progress reports to management. Organizational security and infrastructure: Configure and enforce Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) across email, Git hosting, cloud platforms, CI/CD systems, and Passbolt. Review and improve access permissions while establishing onboarding and offboarding procedures. Strengthen Passbolt security and implement secrets management solutions for applications and pipelines, migrating existing secrets from source code and CI variables. Implement baseline security measures for employee devices, cloud accounts, backups, and logging systems. Develop incident response procedures and organize tabletop exercises with the team. Secure software development: Design and implement a standardized Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) based on OWASP ASVS and OWASP SAMM. Roll out secure development practices across active client projects. Configure and optimize the SecOps platform, reduce false positives, establish pipeline quality gates, and coordinate vulnerability triage. Integrate security scanning tools into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container scanning, DAST, and SBOM generation. Lead threat modeling sessions and document findings for active projects. Conduct security code reviews of high-risk changes and support developers in resolving vulnerabilities. Perform internal application security testing before releases and coordinate external penetration testing activities. Regulatory compliance and certification: Assess the impact of the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, and relevant local regulations on internal operations and client projects. Establish vulnerability handling and disclosure processes, including support for client CRA reporting obligations. Lead hands-on ISO/IEC 27001 preparation activities, including defining scope, conducting risk assessments, preparing the Statement of Applicability, developing policies, and collecting compliance evidence. Coordinate with the relevant certification body throughout the preparation process. Client security services: Help define security service packages and tiers for inclusion in client proposals. Complete client security questionnaires and develop reusable responses. Participate in selected client meetings and discussions, providing senior-level cybersecurity expertise. Team development and knowledge sharing: Work closely with the internal Security Lead, transferring knowledge and supporting their gradual ownership of daily security operations. Organize internal workshops covering topics such as OWASP Top 10, threat modeling, and secure CI/CD practices. Recommend relevant training programs and certification pathways for developers, Security Champions, and DevOps engineers. Requirements: The ideal candidate brings extensive cybersecurity experience and a strong technical background in application security, DevSecOps, and cloud security. This position requires someone who can independently implement security solutions while communicating effectively with both technical teams and management. The following qualifications are expected: At least 8 years of professional experience in information security, including recent hands-on experience in application securi

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Take full ownership of one or two paid acquisition channels, such as Meta, TikTok, Google, Snapchat, Apple Search Ads (ASA), or native advertising platforms, with opportunities to expand responsibilities based on results. Manage, optimize, and scale high-performing acquisition campaigns, progressively increasing advertising budgets while maintaining target customer acquisition costs (CAC) and return on advertising spend (ROAS). Build and optimize scalable user acquisition funnels, from campaign setup and audience targeting to landing pages and conversion optimization. Conduct high-velocity experiments across creatives, audiences, placements, bidding strategies, and campaign formats to identify growth opportunities and improve performance. Monitor campaign performance daily using analytics and tracking tools such as Voluum, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and internal reporting dashboards. Analyze key performance indicators, including CPA, CAC, ROAS, lifetime value (LTV), retention, and cohort behavior, translating insights into actionable acquisition strategies. Develop and maintain reporting frameworks and dashboards to support data-driven decision-making, identify performance trends, and guide budget allocation. Lead the creative briefing process by identifying effective hooks, messaging angles, formats, and concepts based on campaign performance and audience insights. Collaborate with content, creative, and product teams to develop high-converting advertising assets and landing pages, continuously improving the customer journey. Implement creative testing systems and processes to reduce creative fatigue, increase production velocity, and maintain campaign effectiveness at scale. Build and maintain strong relationships with advertising platforms, traffic sources, and external partners, negotiating premium placements and customized commercial opportunities. Research and test new acquisition channels, advertising networks, formats, and tools, establishing clear evaluation criteria before scaling successful initiatives. Stay informed about advertising ecosystem developments, platform policies, algorithm changes, and market trends, adapting strategies to maintain performance and compliance. Identify opportunities to automate campaign management, reporting, and acquisition workflows through internal tools and technology. Create standard operating procedures, playbooks, and structured experimentation pipelines to improve operational efficiency and support sustainable growth. Contribute to ambitious user acquisition objectives, including scaling existing campaigns to more than three times their current budgets and supporting significant expansion of the global user base. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Total Rewards
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Define and lead the global Total Rewards strategy across compensation, benefits, equity, and recognition, ensuring alignment with business objectives and talent attraction, retention, and motivation goals. Develop and implement an AI-forward roadmap for compensation strategy, using artificial intelligence and advanced analytics to improve decision-making, efficiency, consistency, and transparency. Lead the annual compensation cycle, including merit increases, promotions, and equity planning, in close collaboration with People Business Partners, Finance, and business leaders. Own and continuously improve global job architecture, leveling, grading frameworks, and the job catalog, ensuring consistency as the organization scales. Leverage AI and data-driven methodologies for job evaluation, role-to-level mapping, calibration, and detection of inconsistencies or level drift, while maintaining appropriate human oversight. Lead global market benchmarking and compensation analysis, using platforms such as Radford, Pave, or equivalent tools to develop competitive and data-backed recommendations. Apply AI and automation to accelerate compensation benchmarking, pay modeling, scenario analysis, rewards analytics, and employee communications. Manage global benefits programs and relationships with external vendors, including Employer of Record (EOR) providers, benefits brokers, and equity administration platforms. Oversee EOR relationships, monitoring service quality, costs, compliance, and the overall employee experience across different regions. Ensure compliance with pay transparency, pay equity, and local compensation and benefits regulations across all operating jurisdictions, particularly within the European Union and the United States. Partner with Finance to manage compensation budgets, equity pools, and total rewards expenditure, ensuring accurate forecasting and effective cost management. Advise People Business Partners, recruiters, and hiring managers on compensation offers, pay decisions, and exceptions, balancing market competitiveness, internal equity, budget constraints, and talent priorities. Evaluate and introduce new AI and automation solutions while ensuring responsible, explainable, and legally compliant use of technology in rewards processes. Lead, coach, and develop the Total Rewards team, establishing clear priorities, supporting professional growth, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Act as a trusted strategic advisor to senior stakeholders, translating complex rewards data into actionable business recommendations. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Professional certifications such as CCP, CEBS, or equivalent are considered an advantage. At least 8 years of professional experience in Total Rewards, with substantial expertise in compensation and benefits management within global, multi-country technology or SaaS organizations. Demonstrated experience designing and leading global compensation cycles, including merit reviews, promotions, and equity planning. Strong experience in market benchmarking and compensation analysis using platforms such as Radford, Pave, or comparable market data tools. Proven experience managing international benefits programs and external vendor relationships, including EOR providers such as Remote.com, benefits brokers, and equity administration platforms. Strong analytical, financial modeling, and data interpretation skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear, practical, and commercially sound recommendations. Solid understanding of global compensation regulations, pay transparency, and pay equity requirements, ideally covering both European Union and US jurisdictions. Practical experience using AI-powered tools and automation to improve Total Rewards analytics, workflows, benchmarking, and operational efficiency. An AI-forward approach to comp

jobs.title: Staff AI Product Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead the architecture, design, and development of a production-grade multi-agent system capable of safely executing actions across core business tools, including ERP, CRM, spreadsheets, calendars, email, analytics, and compliance platforms. Own the development and continuous improvement of Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations that connect internal business systems with external AI environments and assistants. Design and implement a unified data infrastructure that consolidates information from multiple sources into a centralized layer accessible to AI agents and external tools. Build contextual memory and customer profiling systems that ingest business data and enable increasingly personalized, intelligent AI experiences. Establish robust reliability, observability, permission management, and durable execution mechanisms to ensure agents operate safely on real customer data. Develop and maintain comprehensive evaluation frameworks and automated tests based on real-world customer use cases to measure agent performance and prevent regressions. Define architectural standards, engineering patterns, and best practices for building, testing, deploying, and maintaining agentic systems across the engineering organization. Stay ahead of developments in AI models, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and emerging technologies, incorporating valuable innovations into the product architecture. Rapidly prototype new AI capabilities and present technical concepts and product opportunities to internal teams and customers. Work hands-on with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, continuously improving personal engineering workflows and sharing effective practices with the wider team. Collaborate closely with engineering leadership, product teams, and customers to shape the AI roadmap, prioritize initiatives, and translate business challenges into impactful technical solutions. Provide technical mentorship and influence engineering direction while maintaining a strong focus on execution, product quality, and measurable customer outcomes. Requirements: At least 7 years of full-stack software development experience, ideally building and scaling B2B SaaS applications. Proven, hands-on experience designing and deploying production-grade multi-agent systems, beyond experimental prototypes or personal projects. Demonstrated experience building and maintaining MCP servers or integrations used in production environments. Strong understanding of production engineering principles, including system reliability, observability, security, permissions, and safe workflow execution. Experience combining product thinking with technical leadership, including defining scope, making architectural decisions, and influencing product roadmaps rather than focusing exclusively on implementation. Proficiency in React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, GraphQL, and LangGraph, with the ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies and frameworks. Previous experience in an early-stage startup environment, preferably within an engineering team of fewer than 20 people, with a track record of taking ownership and setting direction in ambiguous situations. Strong practical AI fluency, including daily use of Claude Code or comparable AI development tools, and the ability to build custom agents, skills, and automated workflows. Ability to design and implement effective AI evaluation processes, understand when to use language models versus conventional code, and build appropriate safeguards around AI-generated actions. Experience deploying AI agents to real users with suitable guardrails, monitoring, observability, and rollback mechanisms. Strong product and engineering judgment, with the ability to distinguish high-value opportunities from unnecessary complexity and deliver intuitive AI-powered experiences. Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to raise concerns, propose solutions proactively, and communicate complex tec

jobs.title: Senior AI Content Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Design, write, and continuously refine prompts for AI characters, defining their personalities, tone of voice, behavioral guidelines, and responses to complex or unexpected situations. Create, edit, and maintain high-quality conversational datasets, including dialogues and other text materials used to train and fine-tune AI models. Develop and automate content workflows using AI tools, scripts, and no-code solutions such as Claude, Cursor, and n8n to reduce repetitive manual tasks. Establish evaluation frameworks, quality standards, and criteria for automated content reviews to ensure consistency and reliability. Test new chatbot and model versions before release, assess conversational quality, and identify the root causes of issues related to prompts, datasets, or model behavior. Label, annotate, and organize training data to support model development and improve conversational accuracy. Work closely with machine learning engineers to optimize AI-generated responses and continuously enhance the user experience. Analyze real-world conversations to identify engagement patterns, understand user preferences, and translate insights into actionable content improvements. Maintain clear documentation and consistent standards for writing style, tone, explicitness, and conversational quality. Requirements Demonstrated hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs), conversational AI, or chatbots, including prompt design, dataset development, and model response evaluation. Practical experience shaping chatbot or AI model behavior beyond using AI tools as general writing assistants. Previous experience in AI training, prompt engineering, conversation design, content design, UX writing, copywriting, or professional writing. Strong English writing and editing skills at C1 level or above, with an excellent understanding of tone, style, storytelling, and natural conversational language. Experience automating workflows using AI-powered tools, scripts, no-code platforms, or custom internal solutions. Ability to develop and maintain structured content guidelines, including quality standards, tone-of-voice frameworks, and explicit-content requirements. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to identify patterns across large volumes of conversations and turn findings into practical improvements. Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain consistent quality while handling repetitive content creation, review, and annotation tasks. Full comfort and professional readiness to work with explicit 18+ content. Strong collaboration and communication skills, particularly when working with technical teams and translating content requirements into actionable improvements. Nice to have: Experience in the adult entertainment industry, including AI companions, creator platforms, cam platforms, erotic fiction, interactive storytelling, or dating simulations. Experience creating character-driven content, interactive narratives, or immersive conversational experiences. Basic technical knowledge of regular expressions (Regex), SQL, or similar tools. Additional language skills in Spanish or French. Benefits Fully remote, full-time employment with the flexibility to work from anywhere. Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range communicated during the recruitment process and before employment begins. 28 calendar days of annual paid vacation. 7 additional wellness days per year for personal needs, recovery, and well-being. Children's education reimbursement covering 50% of kindergarten or school expenses, up to $1,000 gross annually per child, subject to eligibility and applicable conditions. Employee referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successfully recommending new hires. 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and industry events. Corporate discounts on English language lessons. Health benefits, including reimbursement of up to $1,000 gr
