jobs.title: User Acquisition Manager | Brainer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Plan, launch, manage, and scale Meta advertising campaigns, focusing on sustainable user acquisition, profitability, and long-term growth. Manage campaign structures, advertising budgets, bidding strategies, and audience segmentation to maximize campaign efficiency and performance. Continuously analyze advertising results, identify performance trends, and uncover new growth opportunities through data-driven decision-making. Collaborate closely with the Creative Marketing Manager to develop, test, and optimize advertising creatives that resonate with target audiences. Design and execute structured A/B tests across creatives, audiences, placements, and campaign strategies to identify the most effective approaches. Monitor and optimize key performance indicators, including CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, retention rates, and LTV, ensuring campaigns meet business objectives. Work alongside analytics and product teams to improve attribution models, tracking accuracy, and overall user acquisition efficiency. Identify underperforming campaigns and implement optimization strategies to improve conversion rates, acquisition costs, and return on advertising spend. Stay up to date with Meta advertising platform updates, performance marketing trends, and emerging acquisition opportunities. Explore and test additional paid acquisition channels, including Snapchat, TikTok, AppLovin, and other relevant platforms, to identify scalable growth opportunities. Make timely, informed decisions based on campaign data, continuously experimenting with new strategies to improve acquisition performance. Share performance insights and recommendations with relevant stakeholders to support broader marketing and business growth initiatives. Requirements: At least 1 year of hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns, preferably within product-based companies or startups offering subscription-based products. Proven experience managing and scaling performance marketing campaigns with measurable results and demonstrated business impact. Strong analytical mindset and confidence working with key performance marketing metrics, including CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, retention, and LTV. Practical experience planning and executing structured A/B tests, analyzing results, and making optimization decisions based on reliable data. Good understanding of paid acquisition strategies, campaign management, audience targeting, and creative performance optimization. Ability to work independently, take ownership of campaign results, prioritize responsibilities, and manage multiple initiatives effectively. Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive and results-oriented approach to identifying and implementing growth opportunities. Self-motivated attitude and willingness to experiment, learn, and adapt in a fast-moving digital environment. English proficiency at B1 level or above, with the ability to communicate effectively with international colleagues. Nice to have: Hands-on experience with additional paid acquisition platforms, such as Snapchat Ads, TikTok Ads, AppLovin, Google Ads, or similar advertising channels. Familiarity with attribution, analytics, and reporting tools such as GA4, Amplitude, Tableau, or equivalent platforms. Experience collaborating closely with creative teams and providing data-driven feedback to improve advertising concepts and performance. Basic copywriting skills and the ability to develop advertising messaging and creative testing hypotheses. Experience using AI-powered tools to improve campaign management, generate creative ideas, analyze performance, or streamline marketing workflows. Previous experience working in subscription-based digital products, mobile applications, or online platforms. jobs.title: Assistant Vice President - Talent Acquisition
jobs.description: JOB PURPOSE Partner with stakeholders to understand their hiring needs and what impact the new hire is expected to make on their team and department. Advertise, source and network to find suitable candidates and always look to support the companies Emiratization goals. This vacancy is for Emiratization only. ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: •Connect with line managers / hiring managers for a comprehensive briefing session before initiating the sourcing activities. •Qualify and understand business and cultural fit requirements to find qualified candidates. •Use recruitment channels to headhunt potential candidates in a timely and effective manner (time to fill/time to hire). •Liaise with the hiring managers to review shortlisted candidates (monitor success and rejection rates) and agree on interviews. •Contact and coordinate with shortlisted candidates for attending interview after validating their initial documents (education, remunerating expectations etc.). •Schedule interviews and coordinate with Recruiting Panel / candidates on decisions and communication. •Attend interviews, assess candidates and provide accurate feedback accordingly. •Prepare offer letters, follow-up with candidates, and answer queries about package and other related job offer information. •Ensure employee journey is adhered to for a positive candidate experience. •Consistently use the internal Applicant Tracking system at Aldar (Lever) •Always think through creative sourcing strategies for roles in the vacancies. •Emiratization Hiring for the group •Manage relationship with external recruitment agencies. Communicate and follow-up with Recruiting agencies (if needed) for specific positions •Schedule/attend recruitments events to source candidates. FIELD OF EXPERIENCE: •Experience in real estate or related industry is preferred. •Background in Executive Search is preferred. •Previous experience in the HR division of a company with 300+ employees. •In-depth knowledge of human resource management best practices. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Director
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Talent Acquisition Director based in Romania. Lead the global talent acquisition strategy for a fast-growing international business operating across technology, sports, media, and digital entertainment. In this strategic leadership role, you will bring recruitment delivery, sourcing, employer branding, data, and technology together to support ambitious business growth. Reporting to the Global HR Director, you will guide a global team and ensure hiring priorities are aligned with business objectives across multiple regions. You will develop recruitment leaders, strengthen operational planning, and build consistent, high-quality hiring practices while adapting to local talent markets. With a strong focus on innovation, you will use AI, automation, and recruitment technology to improve efficiency and decision-making. This is an opportunity to shape a global talent function, influence organisational growth, and make a measurable impact in a dynamic, remote-first environment. Accountabilities: Define and lead the global Talent Acquisition strategy, aligning hiring, sourcing, and employer branding priorities with business objectives across regions. Develop locally relevant recruitment approaches while maintaining a consistent global framework and clear standards. Establish proactive monthly hiring plans, setting priorities, expectations, delivery milestones, and visibility on progress, risks, and outcomes. Lead, coach, and develop recruitment managers, strengthening their leadership, planning, and team management capabilities. Build clear accountability across the talent acquisition function while providing teams with the guidance and support needed to deliver results. Improve recruitment processes and hiring practices, ensuring effective collaboration with hiring managers and a positive, consistent candidate experience. Drive a technology-first recruitment approach by leveraging AI, automation, and recruitment systems to streamline workflows and reduce manual tasks. Strengthen recruitment data quality, reporting, and analytics to support evidence-based decisions and measure hiring performance. Develop and enhance the employer brand, increasing visibility and positioning the organisation as an employer of choice in priority talent markets. Requirements: Demonstrated experience leading global or multi-regional Talent Acquisition teams. Proven ability to translate business priorities into a clear talent acquisition strategy and practical delivery plans. Experience developing recruitment managers and building the leadership capabilities of talent acquisition teams. Strong understanding of the full talent acquisition landscape, including recruitment delivery, sourcing, employer branding, processes, and workforce data. Practical experience using recruitment technology, AI tools, and automation to improve hiring efficiency and effectiveness. Strong strategic thinking, planning, and analytical skills, with the ability to use data and insights to guide decisions. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly when partnering with senior leaders and hiring managers. Flexible, pragmatic leadership style, with sound judgement and the ability to balance global consistency with local market requirements. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, international, and evolving business environment. Benefits: Remote-first working environment. Competitive salary with individual quarterly performance bonuses. Annual leave. Flexible working hours. Employee referral bonuses and additional flash bonuses. Top-of-the-line work equipment. Annual company retreats, offering opportunities to connect and build relationships with colleagues across the business.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Security Engineer based in Romania. As a Security Engineer, you will take ownership of application security for a rapidly growing AI-powered digital platform serving millions of users worldwide. This is a hands-on role focused on identifying vulnerabilities, reviewing code and strengthening security across the entire application stack. Acting as the primary security specialist, you will work closely with technical leadership and engineering teams to define security priorities and implement effective solutions. You will also contribute to securing AI-powered products by identifying emerging threats such as prompt injection, jailbreaks and content filter bypasses. Combining technical execution, independent decision-making and strategic responsibility, you will have the opportunity to shape security practices from the ground up. This fully remote position offers significant autonomy within a fast-paced, innovative and internationally distributed environment. Accountabilities: Own and drive application security across the organisation, proactively identifying vulnerabilities and ensuring security risks are addressed throughout the software development lifecycle. Conduct regular source code reviews to detect security weaknesses before deployment, prioritising critical vulnerabilities and collaborating with engineering teams to implement effective fixes. Coordinate external security audits and penetration tests, critically evaluating findings, challenging assessments when necessary and ensuring remediation actions are completed. Develop and automate security processes, scripts and internal tools to improve vulnerability detection, streamline security operations and support scalability. Integrate AI-powered tools into daily security workflows, leveraging them for code reviews, penetration testing, scripting and security research. Act as the primary security point of contact, independently defining priorities, managing security initiatives and communicating technical risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Monitor and respond to security alerts, including participating in occasional night and weekend on-call rotations. Maintain risk registers and relevant Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) documentation, ensuring security practices remain organised and up to date. Promote security awareness across the organisation by sharing relevant updates, providing guidance and delivering internal security training. Monitor emerging AI-specific security threats, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, content moderation bypasses and vulnerabilities affecting third-party AI providers. Requirements: At least 2 years of hands-on professional experience in cybersecurity, with a strong focus on application security rather than compliance-only or infrastructure-focused responsibilities. Demonstrated experience conducting regular source code reviews and identifying, investigating and resolving real application vulnerabilities, with the ability to explain a concrete example of a vulnerability discovered and fixed. Experience coordinating external security audits or penetration tests and managing remediation efforts through to completion. Strong engineering skills, including experience working with Git/GitHub, scripting in Python or Bash, and hands-on exposure to modern web technologies such as Ruby on Rails or Node.js. Familiarity with cloud and hosting environments such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Heroku or comparable platforms. Proven ability to work independently and take ownership of security activities, ideally having served as a sole security specialist, security lead or independent owner of a security function. Recent practical experience reviewing code or testing systems regularly, ideally on a weekly basis over the past two years. Daily use of AI-powered tools to support security engineering,

jobs.title: Principal BMS & PMS Controls Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Define and own the global BMS and PMS controls architecture, including system boundaries, network configurations, redundancy strategies and integration with facility monitoring and compute infrastructure. Develop and maintain the controls standards library, covering sequences of operation, points schedules, alarm philosophies, naming conventions, and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) requirements. Establish technical requirements for high-density AI data centre environments, including liquid cooling systems, Coolant Distribution Unit (CDU) integration and power-to-compute interfaces. Act as the final technical authority on controls design deviations, vendor proposals and integration challenges across multiple international sites. Collaborate with procurement teams to define vendor strategies, technical evaluation criteria and supplier selection standards. Establish operational technology (OT) security requirements in collaboration with cybersecurity specialists, including network segmentation, access controls and secure remote support. Analyse operational data, incidents and system performance to continuously improve controls standards, reference designs and engineering practices. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to controls engineers and specialist partners, strengthening technical expertise and consistency across the organisation. Requirements: At least 12 years of professional experience in Building Management Systems (BMS), Power Management Systems (PMS) or mission-critical controls engineering, with proven experience in the data centre sector. Demonstrated expertise in defining controls architectures and establishing technical standards across multiple sites or an international project portfolio. Strong understanding of electrical and mechanical control sequences, supervisory control platforms and industrial communication protocols, particularly BACnet and Modbus. Proven experience making, communicating and defending complex technical decisions involving vendors, engineering consultants, designers and senior stakeholders. Practical experience defining and overseeing FAT, SAT and integrated systems testing (IST) procedures for mission-critical controls environments. Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to drive alignment across multidisciplinary teams and geographical regions without relying on direct reporting authority. Strategic thinking, sound technical judgement and a proactive approach to identifying risks and implementing engineering improvements. Nice to have: Experience with controls systems for high-density AI data centres, direct liquid cooling and advanced thermal management technologies. Nice to have: Knowledge of OT cybersecurity principles and controls network architecture, including IEC 62443. Nice to have: Experience standardising controls architectures, specifications and engineering practices across international data centre portfolios. Benefits: Competitive salary package based on the responsibilities and value of the role, rather than previous salary. Equity participation, offering the opportunity to share in the organisation's long-term growth and success. Retirement and pension contributions. Comprehensive healthcare, wellbeing and insurance benefits. Generous annual paid leave entitlement. Opportunity to take on a high-impact technical leadership position within a rapidly growing AI infrastructure environment. Exposure to large-scale, international projects across Europe and North America. Opportunity to shape global engineering standards and influence the development of next-generation mission-critical infrastructure. Supportive working environment focused on professional development, trust, autonomy and work-life balance. Benefits may vary depending on the country of employment and applicable local regulations.

jobs.title: Java Fullstack Software Engineer (Spring Boot / Angular)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Design, develop, and maintain modern Java applications within a scalable microservices architecture. Build and enhance backend services using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot. Develop, integrate, and maintain frontend components and modern web applications using Angular. Design, implement, and integrate RESTful APIs, ensuring clear technical documentation through Swagger. Implement event-driven communication between microservices using Apache Kafka. Containerize, deploy, and support applications using Docker and Kubernetes within modern DevOps environments. Contribute to the development of data-driven optimization solutions in collaboration with machine learning specialists. Maintain high software quality standards through clean code practices, unit testing, code reviews, and established development guidelines. Actively participate in Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, and collaborative development activities while contributing to the achievement of sprint objectives. Work closely with software developers, machine learning engineers, business analysts, and UX specialists to deliver integrated solutions. Share technical knowledge, propose improvements, and contribute to architectural decisions and the continuous evolution of the platform. Requirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. At least 3 years of professional experience in Java software development. Strong knowledge of Java, Spring Framework, and Spring Boot. Practical experience with Angular and the development of modern web applications. Good understanding of Apache Kafka and hands-on experience with microservices architectures. Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and documenting interfaces using Swagger. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, containerization, and modern DevOps practices. Strong commitment to software quality, including clean code principles, unit testing, code reviews, and maintainable development practices. Practical experience working with agile methodologies, particularly Scrum. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and approach technical challenges in a structured, solution-oriented manner. Excellent teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams. Very good written and spoken German and English, enabling effective communication in an international working environment. Benefits: Remote working: Worldwide remote work opportunities, offering flexibility in your working environment. Contract flexibility: Interim engagement with the possibility to contribute to a specialized technology project. Challenging technical environment: Opportunity to develop a modern, scalable logistics platform using microservices architecture and advanced technologies. Modern technology stack: Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Apache Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, and machine learning integrations. Cross-functional collaboration: Work alongside experienced software developers, machine learning engineers, business analysts, and UX specialists. Professional development: Opportunities to expand your technical expertise and contribute to architecture and engineering best practices. Agile working culture: Join a collaborative Scrum DevOps team focused on knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and delivering high-quality solutions. Meaningful impact: Contribute to technology that improves route planning, logistics efficiency, and complex operational processes.

jobs.title: Head of Finance - R&D
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Design and implement a flexible, multi-jurisdictional banking and payment infrastructure to support international digital businesses with complex compliance requirements. Identify, negotiate with, and onboard strategic financial partners, including leading banks, Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs), Payment Service Providers (PSPs), custodians, and financial platforms. Negotiate favorable commercial terms, including transaction fees, payment settlement periods, foreign exchange rates, and hedging solutions. Establish backup banking relationships and alternative payment channels to ensure uninterrupted transaction processing and operational resilience. Manage multi-currency liquidity, working capital, cash pooling, and treasury operations across multiple legal entities. Oversee complex international transfers through SWIFT, SEPA, and ACH networks, optimizing transaction speed, security, and costs. Monitor and reduce treasury-related expenses, including foreign exchange spreads, acquiring fees, and banking charges. Coordinate banking due diligence, manage KYC and AML processes, and maintain effective communication with banking compliance and risk management teams. Ensure long-term stability of banking relationships and payment flows, supporting financial restructurings and corporate changes when required. Build comprehensive treasury and financial operations processes from the ground up, ensuring scalability and operational transparency. Partner with founders and senior executives on financial strategy, unit economics, ROI analysis, and financial modeling. Recruit, develop, and lead a treasury and financial operations team capable of supporting the organization's international growth. Requirements: At least 5 years of experience in a senior finance leadership position, such as CFO, VP of Finance, or Head of Treasury, preferably within fast-growing businesses. Proven track record of opening and managing international bank accounts and building payment infrastructure across multiple jurisdictions. Strong understanding of international AML/KYC standards, cross-border compliance requirements, and the regulatory specificities of different financial jurisdictions. Hands-on experience managing multi-currency funds, foreign exchange exposure, FX risk, and international settlement instruments. Demonstrated ability to negotiate banking and payment service agreements and optimize transaction fees and financial operating costs. Strong knowledge of international payment networks and banking operations, including SWIFT, SEPA, and ACH. Strategic financial mindset, with the ability to translate complex financial challenges into scalable solutions that support business growth. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with experience working directly with founders, senior executives, banking partners, and legal teams. Advanced English proficiency (C1/C2), with the ability to lead complex negotiations and communicate confidently with international financial institutions and legal professionals. High level of autonomy, strategic thinking, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail. jobs.title: Email Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Develop and execute comprehensive email and SMS marketing strategies for 6–7 e-commerce brands using Klaviyo and related platforms. Manage the full campaign lifecycle, including strategic planning, setup, scheduling, quality assurance, launch, and post-campaign analysis. Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, participating in meetings, delivering weekly performance reports, and handling communications through Slack and email. Coordinate with copywriters, designers, and technical specialists to ensure campaigns are delivered accurately, efficiently, and within deadlines. Monitor and optimize campaign performance, focusing on open rates, click-through rates, engagement, and revenue contribution. Conduct A/B testing, develop audience segmentation strategies, and build automated customer journeys to improve conversions and retention. Ensure all campaigns meet quality, deliverability, and regulatory requirements, including GDPR and CAN-SPAM compliance. Organize workflows, priorities, and project timelines using ClickUp and Slack to maintain smooth campaign delivery. Identify performance gaps and growth opportunities, translating data and insights into actionable recommendations for clients. Take increasing ownership of the assigned portfolio, progressing toward independently managing all 6–7 accounts and leading client discussions within the first 90 days. Requirements: At least 3.5 years of hands-on experience in e-commerce email and SMS marketing, with strong practical expertise in Klaviyo. Klaviyo certification is preferred. Proven experience managing multiple brand accounts simultaneously while maintaining high standards of execution and attention to detail. Strong understanding of email and SMS automation, audience segmentation, customer journey mapping, and retention marketing strategies. Experience monitoring campaign performance, conducting A/B tests, interpreting marketing data, and implementing optimization strategies. Familiarity with Figma for reviewing creative assets and project management and communication tools such as ClickUp and Slack. Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate confidently and professionally with international clients. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to identifying opportunities and improving results. Highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities and overlapping deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment. Previous in-house email marketing experience within the fashion or apparel industry is a strong advantage. A portfolio or examples of previous campaigns and results are welcome but not mandatory. Benefits: Competitive compensation, discussed individually based on experience and location. Fully remote working arrangement, offering flexibility in your work environment. Full-time contractor position with a consistent Monday–Friday schedule. Structured working hours from 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM UK time (BST during summer and GMT during winter). Opportunity to work with 6–7 international e-commerce brands and gain exposure to diverse marketing strategies and campaigns. Clear responsibilities, defined performance indicators, and autonomy in managing your accounts. Collaborative environment with experienced copywriters, designers, and technical specialists. Structured workflows, regular feedback, and opportunities for professional development. Opportunity to deepen your expertise in Klaviyo, email automation, SMS marketing, and e-commerce retention strategies.

jobs.title: Affiliate Manager | Partner Company
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Identify, attract, and onboard new affiliate partners, primarily across North America, with potential expansion into additional Tier-1 markets. Build, manage, and develop a portfolio of approximately 20–100 affiliate partners, ensuring strong relationships and consistent performance. Establish clear KPIs with partners, monitor their results, and implement strategies to maintain and improve performance. Monitor traffic quality, conversion rates, acquisition costs, and overall user performance to ensure acquired traffic meets business expectations. Negotiate commercial agreements and partnership terms, including CPA, Hybrid, and Revenue Share (RevShare) models. Develop, coordinate, and regularly update promotional materials, including banners, landing pages, and marketing creatives. Organize affiliate promotions and incentive campaigns, such as bonuses, exclusive offers, and increased commission rates. Monitor competitor activity, market developments, and industry trends to identify new growth opportunities. Analyze affiliate performance and acquired users to assess traffic quality, conversion potential, and the effectiveness of acquisition strategies. Prepare and deliver regular weekly and monthly performance reports, providing insights and recommendations to support business decisions. Independently identify potential partners, establish new industry relationships, and drive market expansion without relying on predefined processes. Requirements: At least 3 years of professional experience in iGaming, affiliate marketing, or traffic acquisition within the iGaming industry. Recent hands-on experience launching or developing a product in the North American market, preferably within the last 12 months. Mandatory experience working directly with SEO affiliates in the North American market under a CPA compensation model. Experience limited to pay-per-listing arrangements or fixed placements will not meet this requirement. Strong understanding of the North American iGaming market, including its specific characteristics, competitive landscape, key industry players, and acquisition dynamics. Solid knowledge of conversion metrics, CPA pricing, and performance-based acquisition models, with the ability to evaluate the quality and commercial value of acquired users. Proven experience generating user acquisition through Facebook (Meta) and SEO channels. Excellent negotiation skills and the ability to establish mutually beneficial commercial agreements with affiliate partners. Strong networking capabilities, with an active network of industry contacts and the ability to build and maintain long-term professional relationships. High levels of independence, initiative, and proactivity, with the ability to identify opportunities and develop new affiliate channels without detailed instructions or established processes. Results-oriented mindset, prioritizing conversion performance, traffic quality, and business outcomes over simply increasing the number of affiliate partnerships. Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify underperforming traffic sources, interpret performance data, and take corrective action quickly. Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple partners, negotiations, and projects while meeting deadlines. Adaptability and resilience, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment characterized by changing priorities and uncertainty. Persistence and confidence when handling negotiations, overcoming objections, and managing rejection. Benefits: 28 business days of paid annual leave. Fully remote working arrangements, with flexible working hours. Medical insurance and access to mental health support services. Financial compensation for professional development, including courses and training programs. English language classes and conversation clubs to support communication skills. Access to an internal learning library and regular educational e

jobs.title: Software Engineer: Core
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer: Core based in Romania. Join a high-performing engineering team building the foundational technology behind a next-generation ecommerce search and discovery platform. In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and operation of highly scalable backend systems that process billions of requests every day. You will work on mission-critical infrastructure powering intelligent search, recommendations, and AI-driven shopping experiences for global ecommerce businesses. Combining distributed systems, performance optimization, and cutting-edge technologies, your work will directly influence platform reliability, speed, and scalability. You will collaborate with experienced engineers in an environment that values technical excellence, ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement. This is an opportunity to tackle complex engineering challenges and make a meaningful impact on technology operating at a global scale. Accountabilities: Design, develop, and maintain the core backend services and infrastructure that power a large-scale search and discovery platform. Build and optimize highly available, distributed systems capable of processing billions of requests daily with exceptional performance and reliability. Develop scalable solutions that support interactions between user requests, customer product catalogs, and intelligent platform capabilities. Contribute to infrastructure design, deployment automation, capacity planning, and production operations. Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve system performance, availability, and resilience across distributed environments. Work across multiple layers of the technology stack, from performance-critical application code to infrastructure and operational systems. Collaborate with engineers across teams to continuously improve architecture, engineering practices, and platform capabilities. Requirements: Strong computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and systems design. Professional experience building, developing, and scaling high-traffic, highly available backend systems. Experience designing and operating backend infrastructure, including deployment automation, capacity planning, and observability. Solid understanding of distributed systems, system performance, reliability, and production environments. Ability to work across different layers of the stack, from low-level, performance-sensitive code to production operations. Familiarity with at least some of the following technologies: Programming languages: Rust, C++, Python. Cloud infrastructure: AWS. CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Actions. Monitoring and observability: Prometheus, Grafana. Curiosity and adaptability, with a willingness to learn new technologies and work in a rapidly evolving, large-scale engineering environment. Strong collaboration and communication skills, combined with a proactive mindset and a sense of ownership. A commitment to continuous improvement and the ability to contribute positively to a collaborative engineering culture. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Annual base salary ranging from $80,000 to $120,000 USD, depending on skills, knowledge, experience, and interview results. Equity participation: Stock options offered in addition to the base salary. Unlimited paid time off: Flexible vacation policy, with employees strongly encouraged to take at least three weeks off annually. Fully remote work: Freedom to work remotely and choose where you live. Home office support: Work-from-home stipend to help you create a comfortable and productive workspace. Equipment provided: Apple laptop supplied to new employees. Learning and development: Annual training and professional development budget. Family support: Maternity and paternity leave for eligible employees. Collaborative environment: Work alongside talented engineer

jobs.title: AI Automation Specialist for Podcast Production (Longform, Shorts, Social Media)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As an AI Automation Specialist, you will evaluate existing content workflows and build reliable systems that streamline podcast production and distribution. Your main responsibilities will include: Reviewing existing podcast episodes, short-form videos, and social media content to identify opportunities for improvement. Recommending AI-powered solutions to automate long-form editing, trailer creation, short-form clips, subtitles, thumbnails, social media posts, and performance reporting. Designing and implementing end-to-end workflows that process video, audio, and text with minimal manual intervention. Integrating AI tools, APIs, automation platforms, and custom scripts to create efficient production pipelines. Testing and refining workflows using real podcast episodes to ensure consistent output quality. Documenting and handing over completed systems so they can operate independently without ongoing support. Monitoring results and measuring improvements through metrics such as views, watch time, and hours saved. Staying informed about emerging AI tools and identifying opportunities to improve the overall content production process. Requirements The ideal candidate is a hands-on automation professional who knows how to build AI-powered systems rather than simply use individual AI tools. The following experience and skills are expected: Proven experience designing and implementing AI-powered automation workflows. Practical experience automating video, audio, or text processing with minimal manual intervention. Familiarity with APIs, n8n, Make, custom scripts, or comparable automation technologies. Strong knowledge of current AI tools for video and audio production, including the ability to assess their practical capabilities and limitations. Understanding of podcast production and the characteristics of engaging short-form content. Interest in financial markets and trading, or willingness to develop knowledge of these topics. Active use of AI features and capabilities across professional tools and workflows. Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently. Clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical solutions and recommendations. Benefits Flexible freelance compensation, with the opportunity to propose a suitable model, such as per project, monthly, or another arrangement. Freedom to choose the tools and technical approach used to build automation workflows. Direct collaboration with the podcast host and short communication channels. Opportunity to take ownership of automation projects and see their impact on a real content operation. Remote working arrangement open to professionals worldwide. Access to vouchers and discounts from more than 1,500 companies.

jobs.title: 2D Game Developer (Defold)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As a 2D Game Developer, you will contribute to the implementation and improvement of game features while ensuring quality, performance, and clear technical documentation. Your main responsibilities will include: Developing and modifying 2D games using the Defold game engine. Writing and maintaining Lua scripts to implement game functionality and logic. Working with Defold game objects, components, animations, and related engine features. Creating and refining gameplay mechanics, player controls, and user interface elements. Debugging technical issues and optimizing game performance. Completing advanced game development tasks and explaining your workflow step by step. Producing clear instructions and detailed prompts for game development assignments. Recording your screen while completing development tasks to demonstrate your process. Requirements The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building 2D games with Defold and can independently complete technical assignments while communicating their approach clearly. The following qualifications are expected: Strong professional experience with the Defold game engine. Practical experience with Lua scripting and 2D game development. Good understanding of Defold game objects, components, animations, and game logic. Ability to develop, troubleshoot, and optimize game features independently. Access to the Defold development environment and the ability to record your screen while working. English proficiency at B2 level or higher. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical workflows clearly. Attention to detail and the ability to follow technical instructions. Benefits Competitive compensation of $70–$130 per hour. Fully remote working arrangement, open to professionals worldwide. Freelance / independent contractor engagement. Flexible work environment with the opportunity to contribute to advanced 2D game development tasks.

jobs.title: Podcast Manager (Guest Booking & Editing)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: You will manage the podcast guest pipeline from prospect identification through post-publication promotion, ensuring every episode is supported by thorough research and effective coordination. Identify and research interesting potential guests, including fund managers, traders, financial authors, entrepreneurs, and other industry experts. Evaluate potential guests and recommend the most relevant and engaging candidates to the podcast host. Conduct guest outreach, manage follow-up communications, and maintain relationships with prospective contributors. Coordinate recording schedules and confirm appointments with selected guests. Research each guest thoroughly, including their professional background, investment track record, publications, books, and previous interviews. Develop tailored interview questions based on each guest's expertise, experience, and professional achievements. Maintain and regularly update the guest pipeline and booking status in Notion. Ensure clear communication and organization across multiple guest bookings and upcoming episodes. Coordinate post-publication guest promotion by encouraging and facilitating the sharing of released episodes. Use AI-powered tools and features to streamline research, outreach, organization, and editorial preparation. Requirements The ideal candidate is genuinely interested in financial markets and trading, combines strong German-language writing skills with excellent organizational abilities, and enjoys working independently in a fast-paced podcast environment. Genuine interest in finance, investing, stock markets, and trading. Ability to understand financial topics and distinguish knowledgeable industry professionals from individuals with limited expertise. Excellent written German skills, with an engaging, natural, and conversational writing style. Strong research skills and the ability to quickly understand a guest's professional background and areas of expertise. Good communication and interpersonal skills for professional outreach and follow-up. Strong organizational and time-management abilities, with the capacity to manage several guest relationships and bookings simultaneously. Ability to work independently, take initiative, and maintain consistent progress without close supervision. Familiarity with Notion or willingness to use it for guest tracking and project coordination. Enthusiasm for AI tools and actively using AI-powered features within everyday workflows. Previous experience in podcast production, guest booking, journalism, editorial research, or financial media is an advantage. An established network within the financial industry is not required, as professional connections can be developed through the role. Benefits Fully remote freelance opportunity, open to candidates worldwide. Flexible compensation structure: propose your preferred payment model, whether per episode, monthly, or through another arrangement. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Marketing
jobs.description: Accountabilities: You will design, build, and operate the next generation of marketing technology while ensuring existing systems remain reliable throughout the transition. Your responsibilities will include: Develop a unified lead intake platform that captures leads from websites, portals, webinars, events, partners, and imported lists, ensuring validation, deduplication, consent management, and enrichment. Build AI-powered lead qualification and scoring capabilities using signals such as product usage, learning activity, website behavior, intent data, and company information. Create intelligent lead routing systems that assign prospects based on territory, team capacity, availability, and priority, with transparent decision records. Improve lead hand-offs by tracking each prospect from initial capture to first sales interaction, identifying delays, and ensuring timely follow-up. Develop a self-service campaign management layer that allows Marketing Operations to configure routing, prioritization, and nurturing rules without creating additional workflows. Design AI-native capabilities that can be accessed through an MCP server, enabling internal agents and assistants to retrieve lead information, explain decisions, and trigger campaign actions. Establish centralized consent and suppression controls, ensuring compliance and consistent data governance across systems. Integrate the platform with CRM, email service providers, visitor identification, enrichment tools, and internal data platforms, ensuring reliable synchronization and recovery mechanisms. Use an agentic software development platform to accelerate delivery while maintaining high standards of code quality, security, testing, and documentation. Maintain existing marketing automation integrations, including CRM synchronization, sales engagement tools, portal and Academy feeds, enrichment services, web forms, and APIs. Investigate and resolve integration incidents, identify root causes, implement lasting fixes, and document technical changes. Manage essential configuration changes in the existing marketing automation platform while avoiding unnecessary complexity during migration. Develop an interim forms gateway and enrollment connector to support the transition away from legacy integrations. Reconcile data across existing and new systems throughout the migration to identify inconsistencies before each cutover milestone. Requirements : The ideal candidate combines strong backend engineering expertise with hands-on experience operating marketing technology integrations and delivering AI-powered product capabilities. You should bring: A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. At least 6 years of experience building and operating production backend systems, including 3 or more years of professional Python development. Recent, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot agent mode, or Codex, with the ability to demonstrate your development, review, and testing workflow. Production experience supporting marketing automation platform integrations, preferably HubSpot, with Marketo or Pardot also considered. Strong understanding of marketing automation APIs, data models, and synchronization with CRM systems. Experience with event-driven architectures and durable execution patterns, including message queues, outboxes, idempotency keys, and replay mechanisms. Experience with Temporal or a comparable workflow engine is highly desirable. Practical integration engineering experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth 2.0, rate limits, retries, and vendor-specific services. Advanced PostgreSQL skills, including schema design, JSONB, partitioning, Alembic migrations, and query performance optimization. Experience deploying cloud-based applications on Azure or AWS, including containers, infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep, GitHub Actions CI/CD, secrets management, and observabil

jobs.title: Senior GMP Manufacturing & AI Advisor
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a senior advisor, you will evaluate manufacturing operations, identify opportunities for AI adoption, and guide the implementation of innovative solutions within GMP-regulated environments. Your responsibilities will include: Analyze end-to-end autogenous vaccine development and manufacturing processes to identify operational bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and decision-making challenges. Assess opportunities to introduce AI-driven solutions, including predictive analytics, document automation, workflow optimization, and intelligent decision-support systems. Develop, evaluate, and prioritize AI initiatives based on technical feasibility, business value, operational impact, and implementation potential. Support the development of regulatory-compliant organizational frameworks aligned with current and emerging AI regulations. Assess manufacturing sites to evaluate their technological maturity, operational readiness, and suitability for AI implementation. Recommend appropriate pilot locations and identify opportunities for initial AI deployment. Conduct stakeholder interviews and gather operational insights to understand business needs and transformation priorities. Present strategic recommendations, implementation roadmaps, and AI adoption opportunities to senior leadership and executive stakeholders. Contribute to the design and development of pilot programs for AI solutions within GMP-regulated manufacturing environments. Define scalable AI deployment strategies that support long-term operational improvements while maintaining regulatory compliance. Ensure AI initiatives align with pharmaceutical quality standards, data integrity requirements, and applicable validation frameworks. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines extensive hands-on pharmaceutical manufacturing experience with recent practical expertise in artificial intelligence and regulatory compliance. You should bring: At least 12 years of hands-on GMP manufacturing experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or animal health industries. Proven operational experience in Production, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing Science and Technology (MS&T), or Engineering. Strong practical knowledge of batch execution, deviation management, and regulatory inspections. Demonstrated experience delivering AI or advanced analytics use cases within GMP-regulated environments during the last 24 months. Expertise in Generative AI and AI agent solutions applied to GxP-regulated processes. Strong understanding of AI and machine learning validation, data integrity, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements. Knowledge of relevant regulatory and validation frameworks, including GAMP 5, Computer Software Assurance (CSA), 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and ALCOA+ principles. Experience conducting manufacturing site assessments and evaluating operational and technological maturity. Up-to-date knowledge of evolving AI regulations and GMP requirements within the pharmaceutical industry. Excellent communication, consulting, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to translate complex technical, operational, and regulatory topics into clear recommendations for executive audiences. Fluent written and spoken English. jobs.title: Media Buyer
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a Media Buyer, you will lead paid acquisition initiatives, drive measurable business growth, and build strong client partnerships. Your responsibilities will include: Develop and oversee paid media strategies across Meta, Google, TikTok, Snapchat, X, and other relevant advertising platforms. Determine budget allocation, campaign structures, audience targeting, and creative priorities to maximize profitable growth. Balance short-term campaign performance with long-term customer acquisition and business growth objectives. Monitor account performance in collaboration with Media Analysts, identifying trends, diagnosing issues, and implementing optimization strategies. Analyze performance fluctuations and determine when to scale campaigns, introduce new tests, reduce investment, or address broader business challenges. Evaluate the complete customer journey and identify opportunities to improve landing pages, conversion rates, pricing, offers, checkout experiences, customer retention, and post-purchase performance. Develop structured testing roadmaps covering audiences, creative concepts, messaging, offers, and campaign structures. Measure experimentation results based on their impact on business performance and use insights to refine future strategies. Collaborate with Creative Strategists to identify creative opportunities, develop performance-driven briefs, and translate customer and media insights into actionable recommendations. Build and maintain strong client relationships based on trust, expertise, and measurable results. Lead strategic client discussions, present performance insights, communicate recommendations, and explain key advertising decisions. Challenge existing assumptions when performance data supports alternative approaches. Proactively identify opportunities to expand account growth through new channels, audiences, creative strategies, offers, and funnel improvements. Leverage data, technology, and AI-powered tools to improve decision-making and campaign effectiveness. Requirements: The ideal candidate is an experienced performance marketer with strong e-commerce expertise, commercial awareness, and the ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on campaign management. You should bring: At least 6 years of experience in paid media, performance marketing, growth marketing, or a related field. Significant experience managing e-commerce clients is essential. Strong hands-on experience managing campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok. Additional experience with advertising platforms such as Snapchat and X is an advantage. Proven experience managing substantial advertising budgets. A track record of developing and executing paid media strategies that deliver measurable business growth. Strong understanding of e-commerce performance metrics, customer acquisition economics, conversion rates, and funnel optimization. Experience with creative testing, offer experimentation, landing page optimization, and customer journey improvements. Experience collaborating with Creative, Analytics, Growth, and other cross-functional teams. Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills. Demonstrated ability to develop and present strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. A commercially driven mindset, with a focus on profitable growth, customer economics, conversion, and retention rather than isolated advertising metrics. The ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and proactively identify opportunities without waiting for direction. Fluency in written and spoken English. Familiarity with data, marketing technology, and AI tools to improve operational efficiency and strategic decision-making. Benefits: Fully remote working arrangement, with opportunities open to candidates globally. Significant ownership and autonomy over a portfolio of e-commerce clients. jobs.title: Teach English Online
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As an Online English Teacher, you will create a positive and supportive learning environment while helping students develop their English language abilities. Your responsibilities will include: Deliver engaging and effective online English lessons to young learners based in China. Adapt teaching methods and lesson delivery to students' individual strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests. Build strong, long-term relationships with assigned students through consistent weekly lessons. Create a warm, encouraging, and judgment-free learning environment that motivates students to develop confidence and enthusiasm for English. Support students in improving their language skills, achieving learning objectives, and progressing toward English proficiency. Maintain a stable and consistent teaching schedule throughout the duration of the contract. Communicate regularly with your dedicated teaching associate to discuss student progress, receive feedback, and address any teaching-related questions. Participate in the onboarding and training process, including the initial teacher boot camp, to prepare for successful classroom delivery. Demonstrate professionalism, reliability, and a genuine commitment to educational excellence. Requirements: The ideal candidate is a responsible, enthusiastic, and student-focused educator who is passionate about helping young learners succeed. You should have: Strong communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with young students in an online learning environment. A genuine passion for teaching English and supporting children's educational development. A strong sense of responsibility, professionalism, and commitment to teaching quality. The ability to create a welcoming, patient, and encouraging learning environment. A reliable high-speed internet connection suitable for uninterrupted online lessons. Access to a high-definition camera and a quality microphone. The ability to maintain a fixed and consistent teaching schedule throughout a long-term engagement. A willingness to participate in the recruitment process, including recorded video questions and a live demonstration lesson. Benefits: Stable and predictable teaching hours, providing consistent weekly income. Regular student assignments through a fixed student-teacher pairing model. Long-term employment opportunities, with an initial commitment of at least one year. Fully remote teaching opportunities. The ability to build meaningful, lasting relationships with students through recurring lessons. Dedicated support from an associate who provides guidance, feedback, and assistance with student-related matters. Structured onboarding and teacher boot camp to help you prepare for your first classes. Ongoing professional support throughout the teaching engagement. A collaborative teaching environment focused on educational quality and student development. The opportunity to make a meaningful difference in young learners' lives through English education.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Data Platforms
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: As a strategic product leader, you will oversee the development and lifecycle management of data platform products while ensuring alignment between technical capabilities and organizational priorities. Your responsibilities will include: Define and drive product strategy, priorities, and roadmaps across four key domains: data engineering, search, experimentation, and site reliability. Ensure the accuracy, reliability, accessibility, and practical value of data products and services. Lead product lifecycle management for the technologies, tools, and services developed by Data Platform Engineering teams. Collaborate with the Director of Engineering for Data Platform Engineering to establish strategic direction, facilitate decisions, and ensure effective execution. Guide the evolution of data infrastructure, including data pipelines, data lakes, experimentation platforms, and analytics tools. Oversee product capabilities covering data ingestion, orchestration, computation, and serving across technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Hadoop, Spark, Airflow, Iceberg, Kubernetes, Superset, dbt, and OpenSearch. Partner with user-facing product teams, researchers, and data analysts to leverage platform capabilities for product decisions and the development of derived-data products. Manage, mentor, and develop a team of two individual-contributor Product Managers. Foster effective collaboration across engineering, research, analytics, and product teams to deliver impactful solutions. Promote iterative product delivery, prioritizing minimum viable solutions that create value for internal customer teams. Communicate product strategies, roadmaps, priorities, and decisions clearly to technical contributors, volunteer communities, and organizational leadership. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines strong technical product management expertise with proven people leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to navigate complex data ecosystems. You should bring: At least 5 years of product management experience focused on data, infrastructure, or analytical products. Demonstrated experience hiring, managing, and developing Product Managers. A successful track record of delivering data platforms, analytical products, and services used by multiple product teams. Strong expertise in data analytics, A/B testing, search technologies, and data architecture. A solid understanding of modern techniques and technologies for processing, managing, and serving high-volume data. Technical familiarity with data engineering ecosystems, including data pipelines, orchestration, distributed computing, and analytics infrastructure. Knowledge of search technologies and their application within large-scale digital products. Experience addressing privacy considerations related to data collection, retention, access, and distribution. Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to achieve results through collaboration and influence across multiple teams. Excellent asynchronous communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a geographically distributed organization. Sound judgment and decision-making abilities, particularly when dealing with incomplete, ambiguous, or conflicting information. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document strategies, plans, roadmaps, and decisions for audiences with different levels of technical expertise. A commitment to iterative delivery, practical prioritization, and continuous improvement. Alignment with the mission and values of open knowledge, collaboration, and free access to information. Additional assets: Experience working with open-source software, open data, or open knowledge communities. Experience developing products for multiple languages, regions, and international audiences. Familiarity with integrating machine learning or artificial intelligence capabilities into web products. Experience editing Wikipedia or participating in Wikipedia, Wikidata, Wikimed

Prioritize newly qualified prospects, scheduled callbacks, and follow-ups before working through older leads as time permits. Identify homeowners who are genuinely planning a move and determine whether they represent a suitable business opportunity. Gather essential qualification details, including expected moving date, local or long-distance relocation, destination, approximate home or moving size, and whether the prospect has already selected a moving provider. Handle routine questions, objections, and concerns naturally, confidently, and professionally without applying excessive sales pressure. Respect customer preferences, including immediately honoring explicit declines and Do Not Call requests. Offer warm transfers to the sales team when qualified prospects are available and interested in speaking with a salesperson. Complete the required internal lead form before initiating a warm transfer to ensure the sales team has relevant customer information. When a live transfer is unavailable, arrange or request virtual or on-site moving estimates. Submit qualified leads through approved lead forms or website workflows, ensuring accurate and complete information. Avoid entering unqualified prospects into the sales system. Participate in coaching sessions and adapt scripts, outreach strategies, and calling approaches as the pilot evolves. jobs.title: Customer Service Administrator
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Make outbound calls to tenants to coordinate and confirm upcoming property health and safety inspections. Handle inbound calls from tenants and customers, responding to questions about inspections, appointments, scheduling, and related services. Follow approved call scripts and communication guidelines while maintaining a professional, friendly, and engaging telephone manner. Coordinate inspection appointments between tenants, landlords, and service providers, ensuring schedules are accurate and efficiently managed. Respond to tenant inquiries and concerns regarding scheduled inspections, property access, and compliance-related procedures. Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of customer interactions, appointment bookings, confirmations, and follow-up activities. Follow up on missed or unsuccessful appointments and arrange rescheduling when necessary. Book inspection jobs and service appointments by telephone and through online booking platforms. Manage tenant communications related to property health and safety compliance, ensuring relevant information is shared clearly and promptly. Support increased operational demand during peak compliance periods, particularly between August and March. Collaborate with an established customer support and administrative team managing a large portfolio of client relationships. Contribute to the delivery of efficient customer service as the business expands its property and trade service offerings. Complete all assigned tasks according to agreed service standards, deadlines, operational procedures, and contractual deliverables. Requirements: Previous experience in customer service, call handling, appointment scheduling, virtual assistance, or administrative support. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills, with a professional and confident telephone manner. Strong numerical and mathematical skills, with the ability to handle scheduling information and administrative data accurately. Fast and accurate typing skills, ideally between 60 and 70 words per minute (WPM). Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate customer records and appointment information. Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple schedules and competing priorities. Ability to handle sensitive conversations involving property access, health and safety compliance, and tenant concerns with patience, diplomacy, and professionalism. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with multiple stakeholders while maintaining high customer service standards. Ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, prioritize tasks, and consistently meet deadlines. Familiarity with online booking systems and administrative tools. Knowledge of UK rental property regulations, property compliance requirements, and tenant rights is considered an advantage. Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with international teams. Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time. Willingness to work under an independent contractor agreement rather than a traditional employment contract. Benefits: Competitive compensation rates. Weekly payments for completed services, according to the engagement terms. Fully remote working opportunity, with the possibility of working from any region. Access to free training and professional upskilling opportunities. Ongoing support, guidance, and assistance throughout the engagement. Access to a vibrant international community of virtual assistants and independent professionals. Opportunities to explore various additional client assignments and open positions. Potential for professional growth as the business expands into new services and markets. Structured working arrangements with clearly defined responsibilities and contracted hours. jobs.title: Infrastructure Operations Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Manage employee onboarding, offboarding, and access-management requests in accordance with established security procedures, ensuring appropriate approvals, least-privilege access, and verification of completed actions. Take ownership of common Linux and infrastructure requests and incidents, from initial triage and troubleshooting through resolution or escalation to the appropriate technical owner. Perform standard host provisioning and production-server changes across bare-metal infrastructure, private cloud, and public cloud environments, following approved procedures and escalating non-standard requirements. Troubleshoot DNS-related issues and execute authorized DNS and domain-management changes in accordance with established operational guidelines. Implement approved firewall and operating-system changes, ensuring appropriate rollback procedures and post-change verification. Monitor infrastructure performance, investigate alerts, and respond to operational incidents while prioritizing actual service availability and business impact. Keep stakeholders and requesters informed throughout incident resolution, providing regular updates until service recovery has been confirmed. Distinguish genuine infrastructure issues from alert noise and improve alert routing, escalation paths, and ownership where necessary. Manage Jira requests according to agreed priorities and response times, ensuring clear communication and consistent follow-up. Deploy standard infrastructure services using approved specifications, procedures, and operational runbooks, escalating architectural or design decisions when required. Maintain clear and accessible technical documentation to support recurring operational activities and ensure effective team coverage. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through small-scale automation, particularly across onboarding, offboarding, access management, and access-review processes. Collaborate with infrastructure colleagues in a distributed environment to maintain service reliability, security, and continuous operational improvement. Requirements: Hands-on experience troubleshooting Linux systems in a professional or production-like environment, with preference for Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) family distributions. Good working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS, with the ability to identify and isolate operating-system, network, and application-level issues. Practical experience with at least one virtualization platform or cloud environment. Demonstrated ability to independently manage technical incidents and support tickets, including gathering evidence, assessing business impact, prioritizing tasks, communicating progress, verifying recovery, and escalating issues with clear technical findings. Experience implementing standard production changes safely, including rollback planning and post-implementation verification. Ability to understand, maintain, and modify existing automation scripts or develop small improvements using Bash or Python. Practical experience using AI assistants to support troubleshooting, scripting, and technical documentation, with the ability to independently validate outputs before implementing production changes. Strong written and spoken English skills, with the ability to communicate effectively in an asynchronous, remote-working environment. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, combined with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving technical issues. Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail when managing infrastructure requests and operational responsibilities. Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a distributed technical team. Nice-to-have: Experience with OpenNebula, KVM, or other private-cloud and virtualization technologies. Familiarity with Ansible or other configuration-manageme

jobs.title: Project Manager Digital Solutions
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager Digital Solutions based in Romania. As Project Manager Digital Solutions, you will lead the adoption and integration of AI and digital solutions across a global project management organization. You will drive digital transformation initiatives that enhance project execution, improve productivity, and enable data-driven decision-making. Working closely with cross-functional teams and regional stakeholders, you will translate business needs into scalable, impactful digital solutions. You will oversee initiatives from strategy and evaluation through implementation and global deployment. You will also promote responsible AI practices, strengthen digital capabilities, and encourage knowledge sharing across international teams. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of project management in a dynamic, global, and technology-driven environment. Accountabilities: Develop and implement a global AI and Digital Solutions roadmap aligned with business priorities and enterprise digital strategies. Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI, analytics, and automation opportunities based on business value, feasibility, scalability, and user impact. Lead the end-to-end development, testing, piloting, deployment, and scaling of digital solutions to improve project delivery, productivity, and decision-making. Translate business and project management needs into clear functional requirements, collaborating with regional teams, IT, Data, and other relevant stakeholders. Coordinate digital initiatives across regions, encouraging alignment, knowledge sharing, and the reuse of successful solutions while avoiding duplicated efforts. Partner with IT, Data, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Architecture teams to ensure solutions meet security, integration, scalability, and enterprise standards. Develop business cases and define performance indicators to measure efficiency gains, adoption rates, process improvements, and overall business impact. Drive process automation and digital workflow improvements to reduce administrative tasks and enhance project management effectiveness. Coordinate global pilots and rollouts, ensuring effective stakeholder engagement, communication, change management, and user adoption. Ensure compliance with corporate AI governance, cybersecurity, data privacy, data quality, and regulatory requirements. Monitor emerging AI and digital technologies and assess their potential applications within the global project management environment. Manage and continuously improve the Project Management digital platform, ensuring access to relevant tools, initiatives, training resources, community content, and events. Build and nurture a global project management community that promotes cross-regional collaboration, knowledge sharing, and best-practice adoption. Develop and deliver training, coaching, and communication initiatives to strengthen AI literacy and digital capabilities across the organization. Requirements: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business, Data, Project Management, or a related discipline. Significant experience in project or program management within a complex, global, and matrixed organization. Proven track record of leading and delivering large-scale, cross-functional transformation initiatives. Previous experience in digital transformation, business transformation, analytics, AI, consulting, or technology-driven environments. Practical understanding of artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, automation, data management, and cloud technologies. Develop and oversee structured test-and-learn programmes, using hypotheses, experiments, and measurable results to continuously improve campaign performance. Manage paid media budgets exceeding $1 million, making informed investment decisions and providing clear justification for spend allocation. Present campaign performance to clients through regular reporting, actionable insights, and data-driven recommendations. Mentor a Paid Media Executive and establish consistent team standards, including reporting templates, naming conventions, quality assurance, and campaign management practices. Collaborate with strategy and creative production teams to integrate paid media with creator-led campaigns. Monitor platform developments and channel trends, translating changes into practical recommendations for campaign strategy. Requirements: At least 5 years of experience in digital paid media, either in-house or agency-side. Extensive hands-on experience managing and optimising campaigns across TikTok and Meta. jobs.title: Frontend Developer (React)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Design, develop, and maintain user-facing features and interactive components for web applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript. Build reusable UI components and libraries that support consistency, scalability, and maintainability across the application. Translate complex Figma designs into accurate, responsive frontend implementations using modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript technologies. Collaborate with design, product, and backend teams to ensure technical feasibility, seamless integrations, and high-quality user experiences. Optimize application performance, speed, and scalability while maintaining clean architecture and coding standards.
