Collaborative and supportive team environment with passionate colleagues. Startup-style culture offering opportunities for professional development and career growth. Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period. Regular team activities and gatherings. Open communication culture with direct feedback and collaborative working practices. Opportunity to contribute meaningfully to product development and technical decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst / Data Scientist
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Define, develop, and maintain core product and business metrics, establishing a reliable single source of truth that supports decision-making across Product, Finance, and Sales. Build a comprehensive understanding of self-service customers by analyzing usage patterns, customer health, satisfaction, retention risks, unmet needs, and potential growth opportunities. Collect, process, and analyze large-scale customer, product, and operational datasets to uncover trends, identify business opportunities, and support strategic decisions. Translate customer demand, business objectives, and commercial plans into accurate capacity forecasts, helping teams make informed capacity allocation decisions. Monitor and evaluate effective capacity utilization, identifying opportunities to optimize available resources and maximize their commercial value. Design, assess, and improve pricing and packaging strategies, including guaranteed capacity, on-demand pricing, customer commitments, clawback mechanisms, and provisioned throughput units. Develop data-driven recommendations for self-service and managed service offerings, covering customer segmentation, pricing structures, capacity planning, and monetization opportunities. Take end-to-end ownership of analytical projects, from defining business questions and building data pipelines to conducting statistical analyses and delivering production-ready solutions. Use Python, SQL, statistical methods, and distributed data-processing tools to generate reliable insights and support scalable analytical workflows. Leverage AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development and analysis while ensuring the accuracy, quality, and reliability of the resulting solutions. Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations that influence product strategy, commercial decisions, and operational improvements. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Applied AI, Finance, Sales, and Operations to turn insights into measurable business impact. Requirements: At least 5 years of professional experience in product analytics, data science, business analytics, or a closely related analytical discipline. Strong technical proficiency in Python and SQL, combined with a solid understanding of statistics and the analytical methods used to interpret complex datasets. Proven ability to take analytical projects from initial business questions through data preparation, analysis, solution development, and production-ready implementation. Experience defining business and product metrics, building reliable analytical datasets, and establishing consistent reporting frameworks. Strong commercial and product judgment, with the ability to balance customer value, monetization, business growth, and profitability. Practical experience with pricing, packaging, monetization strategies, or commercial analytics, ideally within technical, subscription-based, or consumption-based products. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and analytical insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager (fixed term)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Marketing Operations and Project Management: Maintain a comprehensive overview of ongoing marketing projects, tracking deadlines, dependencies, priorities and potential risks across the department. Coordinate recurring departmental meetings, document key decisions, assign action items and ensure timely follow-through. Proactively follow up with team members and stakeholders to resolve routine blockers and keep projects progressing. Provide leadership with concise, regular updates on project progress, emerging risks, priorities and decisions requiring attention. Identify situations requiring management input and present clear recommendations or alternative solutions. Campaign and Launch Coordination: Support campaign leads in translating strategic priorities into actionable project plans with clearly defined responsibilities, timelines, deliverables and launch dates. Coordinate activities across copywriting, design, web development, email marketing, events and Sales to ensure successful campaign execution. Keep project management platforms organized, updated and consistently used across the department. Consolidate routine information from existing reports and dashboards to provide leadership with relevant operational insights. Help maintain visibility and accountability across workflows, ensuring teams have the information and tools needed to deliver effectively. Maintain clear records of process changes and unresolved priorities throughout the contract period. Proven experience coordinating multiple projects simultaneously and managing deadlines, dependencies and deliverables across cross-functional teams. Strong understanding of marketing operations and the processes involved in campaigns, product launches, webinars, events and Sales handoffs. Ability to assess campaign readiness, identify missing elements and anticipate operational challenges before they affect execution. Experience coordinating stakeholders and influencing progress without having direct managerial authority over contributors. Familiarity with project management platforms, CRM systems and marketing automation tools. HubSpot experience is considered an advantage. Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment. jobs.title: Real Estate Transaction Coordinator Virtual Assistant
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Transaction Coordination: Manage real estate transactions from executed contract through closing, ensuring all milestones, contingency dates and deadlines are properly tracked and met. Coordinate routine communication between agents, clients, lenders, title and escrow companies, inspectors and other transaction stakeholders. Proactively follow up on outstanding documents, signatures, approvals and action items to prevent delays. Keep agents and relevant parties informed about transaction progress, upcoming deadlines and outstanding requirements. Identify potential issues and escalate contractual questions, negotiations and matters requiring the involvement of a licensed real estate professional. Contracts and Documentation: Prepare transaction documents using agent-provided information, brokerage-approved templates and established procedures. Send documents for electronic signatures, monitor completion and verify that all required fields, dates, initials and signatures are present. Review and maintain complete, accurate and well-organized transaction files in accordance with brokerage checklists and compliance procedures. Identify missing, inconsistent or incomplete documentation and flag it for agent or broker review. Listing and MLS Support: Assist with listing intake, organize property information and maintain accurate listing records. Enter and update approved listing information in MLS platforms when authorized by the client and applicable procedures. Support listing documentation, status updates and other related coordination activities. Administrative and Communication Support: Manage transaction-related emails, scheduling, reminders and follow-ups. Update transaction management platforms, CRMs and task-management systems to ensure accurate records and efficient workflows. Prepare transaction status reports and maintain organized checklists across multiple active transactions. Support improvements to transaction processes, documentation workflows and handoff procedures when appropriate. Maintain professional communication, confidentiality and adherence to agreed deliverables, timelines and independent contractor engagement requirements. Requirements: Previous hands-on experience in real estate transaction coordination is required. Experience supporting U.S.-based real estate transactions is strongly preferred, with a solid understanding of the contract-to-close process. Working knowledge of real estate contracts, disclosures, contingencies, transaction timelines and closing procedures. Strong document review, transaction file-management and administrative coordination skills. Excellent written and spoken English proficiency, with a native or near-native level of communication preferred. Strong organizational skills, exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines and transactions simultaneously. Proven ability to communicate professionally with real estate agents, clients, lenders, title and escrow companies, vendors and other transaction stakeholders. A proactive approach to follow-ups, problem identification and deadline management. Ability to work effectively within established brokerage procedures, checklists and compliance guidelines. Good judgment in distinguishing administrative matters from contractual or legal questions that must be escalated to licensed professionals. Ability to quickly learn state-specific real estate forms, brokerage procedures and client-specific software. MLS experience is preferred, as is previous experience with residential real estate transactions. Commercial real estate experience is an additional advantage. Spanish-English bilingual proficiency is a plus. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating with U.S.-based teams. jobs.title: Video Producer | Presenter-Led Content
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Develop and execute a presenter-led content strategy aligned with the presenter's voice, interests, travel schedule and access to stories. Proactively identify and pitch original stories, timely reactions and fresh editorial angles, particularly around social justice and underrepresented communities. Conduct in-depth research, identify credible sources and uncover compelling details to build accurate and engaging narratives. Write scripts tailored to on-camera delivery, incorporating strong hooks, natural spoken language and effective storytelling techniques. Create distinctive recurring shows and content formats, including explainers, podcasts, interviews and documentaries. Identify relevant contributors, interview opportunities and local stories based on the presenter's travel destinations. Prepare comprehensive presenter briefs, interview questions, filming plans and story outlines to ensure efficient production. Produce on-camera content remotely or on location, providing guidance and feedback on delivery, clarity, pacing and performance. Collaborate with editors to transform raw footage into polished productions, incorporating supporting visuals, graphics and sound. Develop compelling titles, thumbnails and social media copy to maximize content visibility and audience engagement. Monitor content performance, audience retention and engagement metrics, using insights to continuously improve future productions. Maintain rigorous editorial standards, factual accuracy and journalistic integrity throughout the entire production process. Requirements: 4–5 years of professional experience in digital journalism, video production, documentary filmmaking or a related field. Demonstrated experience producing presenter-led content and working directly with on-camera talent. A strong portfolio of published work, including projects that have generated millions of views, with a clear understanding of your individual contribution. Excellent research, scripting, editorial judgment and storytelling abilities. Strong understanding of digital audiences and content distribution strategies across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook. Ability to create compelling short-form content with attention-grabbing hooks, as well as develop engaging narratives for longer productions. Experience developing creative concepts, managing production workflows and coordinating multiple projects independently. Strong organizational skills, adaptability and initiative to manage deadlines and production schedules around a frequently traveling presenter. A genuine commitment to social justice and a decolonial understanding of power, politics and representation, including the ability to question dominant narratives, recognize overlooked perspectives and examine whose interests stories serve. A commitment to journalistic rigor, including fact-checking, challenging assumptions and ensuring that editorial decisions are supported by credible evidence. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across remote, international and multidisciplinary teams. jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Strategic Planning & Execution Coordinate and manage the company's goal-setting processes, monitoring progress against key objectives and identifying potential deviations. Support leadership in defining, implementing, and tracking Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to ensure alignment across departments. Conduct market, business, and operational research to develop actionable insights and recommendations that support strategic decision-making. Analyze organizational performance and help identify opportunities to improve execution and achieve business objectives. Decision-Making & Leadership Alignment Ensure employees have timely access to relevant business information, promoting transparency, alignment, and informed decision-making. Conduct analyses and experiments to evaluate business opportunities, identify trends, and recommend improvements. Prepare strategic content, presentations, and performance updates for company-wide meetings, leadership discussions, and team offsites. Support communication and alignment between senior leadership and cross-functional teams. Process Improvement & Operational Excellence Collaborate with department leaders to implement and continuously improve company-wide operating processes and frameworks. Develop efficient systems for knowledge sharing, documentation, and collaboration across a distributed workforce. Manage and continuously improve Notion as the organization's central knowledge management platform and Single Source of Truth. Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions to streamline workflows and improve productivity. Support high-priority business initiatives and contribute wherever additional operational or strategic support is needed. Explore and promote the use of AI tools and emerging technologies to improve internal processes and overall business efficiency. Requirements: 3–6 years of relevant professional experience in management consulting, technology investment banking, venture capital, startup operations, or a combination of these fields. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with demonstrated experience using data and research to inform business decisions. Good understanding of SaaS business models and key financial and operational metrics, including revenue, margins, operating costs, and cash burn. Ability to interpret financial reports, assess business performance, and develop informed perspectives on organizational health. Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive approach to managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality work. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and interact effectively with senior stakeholders. Proven stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across different functions and influence outcomes without direct authority. Adaptability and a willingness to work in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities evolve and ambiguity is part of everyday operations. A continuous improvement mindset, combined with initiative, curiosity, and a practical approach to problem-solving. Genuine interest in AI tools and their potential to improve business operations, with a willingness to experiment, share insights, and contribute to broader AI adoption. Proficiency with macOS and confidence working remotely with collaboration and productivity tools such as Slack, Google Workspace, and Zoom. Strong written English skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different time zones and geographical locations. Benefits: Competitive salary: The advertised annual salary range is $92,000–$125,000 for US-based candidates, depending on geographical location, experience, and expertise. Compensation for Poland-based candidates will be determined according to regional benchmarks and discussed during the recruitment process. Remote-first flexib

jobs.title: Vice President, Intelligence & Impact
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Partner with the CEO and senior leadership team to define organizational strategy, establish priorities, and guide resource allocation based on evidence, expected impact, and strategic objectives. Evaluate the organization's global portfolio of initiatives, assessing their effectiveness, feasibility, cost-efficiency, strategic alignment, and potential to improve animal welfare outcomes. Provide data-driven recommendations on which programs and initiatives should be expanded, maintained, redesigned, or discontinued, while identifying opportunities for geographic expansion, new program areas, and strategic partnerships. Develop a proactive strategic intelligence function to monitor emerging trends, risks, and opportunities across animal agriculture, corporate practices, public policy, technology, and relevant markets. Translate complex research, external developments, and quantitative and qualitative data into clear, actionable recommendations that support organizational strategy and systemic change. Establish an organization-wide impact measurement framework, including meaningful performance indicators, evaluation methodologies, and learning mechanisms to assess effectiveness across programs and geographies. Ensure that insights and evaluation findings consistently inform strategic decisions, operational improvements, and resource allocation. Lead technology-enabled transformation by identifying opportunities to improve productivity and organizational effectiveness through AI, automation, integrated data systems, and emerging technologies. Oversee the development, integration, and adoption of technology solutions that streamline workflows, strengthen decision-making, and improve operational performance. Define and implement a practical technology roadmap, prioritizing investments according to organizational needs, expected value, scalability, and implementation feasibility. Collaborate with IT to ensure technology solutions and data systems are secure, integrated, scalable, and aligned with organizational priorities. Build and lead a lean, multidisciplinary Intelligence & Impact team covering strategy, research, impact assessment, analytics, and technology development. Act as a trusted strategic advisor to the CEO, offering independent perspectives, challenging assumptions, and delivering clear, decision-ready recommendations. Work closely with regional and functional leaders to strengthen execution capabilities, encourage collaboration, and maintain accountability for measurable results. Contribute actively to senior leadership discussions and organization-wide decision-making, fostering a culture of evidence-based thinking, innovation, and continuous improvement. Requirements: Significant senior leadership experience in strategy, organizational transformation, analytics, impact evaluation, technology, or a related discipline. Proven ability to assess complex opportunities, navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and translate sophisticated analysis into practical strategic decisions. Strong quantitative, qualitative, financial, and operational skills, with the ability to combine analytical rigor with sound business judgment. Demonstrated experience leading technology-enabled transformation initiatives, including systems development or integration, AI adoption, automation, and process optimization. Experience developing and implementing performance measurement frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and data-informed decision-making processes. Proven ability to build and lead multidisciplinary teams, influence senior stakeholders, and collaborate effectively across functions, cultures, and geographical regions. Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to identify opportunities for greater efficiency, collaboration, and long-term impact. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to present complex findings clearly and influence decisions at exe

jobs.title: Director of B2B Marketing
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Serve as a senior strategic marketing partner for a portfolio of B2B clients, providing direction, expertise, and ongoing counsel. Develop integrated marketing strategies and plans aligned with client business objectives, target audiences, and growth priorities. Translate business goals into actionable channel strategies, campaigns, performance indicators, and measurement frameworks. Build strong relationships with client executives and confidently communicate strategic recommendations, campaign results, and opportunities. Identify opportunities to expand and strengthen client marketing programs based on performance insights and changing business needs. Manage relationships with external vendors and partners to support effective execution and scalable results. Lead paid and organic B2B marketing strategies across relevant channels, including paid search, paid social, display advertising, and retargeting. Oversee organic growth initiatives across Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Search Engine Optimization (SEO), content marketing, and organic social media. Develop audience segmentation, targeting, messaging, and channel recommendations based on buyer behavior and client objectives. Continuously test and optimize campaigns to improve engagement, demand generation, conversion rates, and return on investment. Provide strategic direction and oversight to cross-functional teams supporting B2B client accounts, ensuring consistent quality and accountability. Contribute to new business development through marketing strategy, proposals, pitches, and client presentations. Collaborate with senior leadership to establish best practices, improve workflows, and strengthen the organization's B2B marketing capabilities. jobs.title: (Senior) FP&A Manager
jobs.description: Accountabilities: In this role, you will take ownership of financial planning and performance management, providing strategic insights and supporting business-wide decision-making. Your main responsibilities will include: Lead annual budgeting, monthly and quarterly forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes across the business. Translate financial and operational performance into actionable insights through variance analysis, identifying risks, opportunities, and recommendations for senior leadership. Partner with commercial, operational, functional, local finance, and group finance teams to support strategic initiatives and improve business performance. Develop and maintain robust financial models, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting packages to support decision-making and investment cases. Ensure alignment between local German reporting requirements and group-level expectations within a U.S. publicly listed company environment. Drive continuous improvements across FP&A processes, planning tools, data quality, reporting automation, and performance management routines. Collaborate with external auditors, system implementation partners, and corporate reporting teams to ensure consistency and accuracy across financial processes. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong financial expertise with commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and the ability to influence stakeholders in an international business environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected: Approximately 7 years of progressive experience in FP&A, controlling, corporate finance, or a related finance function, preferably within an international or matrixed organization. Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, management reporting, variance analysis, and business performance management. Good understanding of the relationships between the balance sheet, profit and loss statement, and cash flow statement. Advanced Excel skills and practical experience with ERP, financial planning, and reporting tools such as Oracle NetSuite, Oracle Fusion, Power BI, Tableau, Anaplan, Hyperion, OneStream, or similar platforms. Strong commercial mindset, analytical capabilities, and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence strategic decisions. Fluent English is required. Experience preparing board materials, earnings support schedules, management review packs, or group reporting deliverables is a plus. Exposure to finance transformation, planning system implementation, BI dashboards, or reporting automation projects is an advantage. An MBA, CFA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent professional qualification is considered a strong asset. Previous experience in a high-growth, complex, multinational, or publicly listed company environment is beneficial. Benefits Competitive salary: Starting from €55,000 gross per year, depending on location, skills, and experience. Remote-first flexibility: Fully remote position within a time zone of approximately ±2 hours of Central European Time. Work from anywhere: Access to a flexible working arrangement through a dedicated WorkFlex program. Well-being support: A dedicated Well-Being Day to recharge and focus on personal well-being. Fitness benefits: Subsidized gym memberships to support an active and healthy lifestyle. Learning and development: Training and Development Allowance to invest in professional growth and expand your skills. Team connection: Annual team meetups bringing together colleagues from across the globe. Inclusive culture: Work in a diverse, international, and collaborative environment that values different perspectives and equal opportunities.

jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Digital Marketing Specialist, you will manage the operational and creative execution of digital marketing campaigns, ensuring that every channel and customer touchpoint is properly configured, consistent, and optimized. Your responsibilities will include: Set up, maintain, and quality-check webinar landing pages and supporting technical elements, including automated emails, call-to-action buttons, and tracking links. Moderate live webinars, ensuring smooth technical delivery and strong audience engagement. Write, edit, and implement conversational copy for ManyChat chatbot automations. Build, configure, and optimize trigger-based automated chatbot flows. Research and evaluate promotional channels, identify suitable placement opportunities, and communicate with channel administrators. Create and proofread persuasive promotional copy for channel placements and seeding campaigns. Track campaign activity and results in spreadsheets, monitoring performance and conversion rates. Write, configure, and manage email marketing campaigns and automated sequences. Create and manage call-booking links and scheduling workflows in HubSpot. Maintain the company website through regular content updates and adjustments. Requirements The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented digital marketing professional who combines strong copywriting skills with hands-on technical execution. You should be comfortable managing several marketing activities independently while maintaining consistent quality and reliable follow-through. Excellent attention to detail, organization, and consistency. Ability to manage multiple campaigns and workflows while maintaining high-quality standards. Additional advantages: Experience managing website content through platforms such as WordPress. Previous digital marketing experience in the recruitment or human resources sector. Familiarity with marketing automation, webinar platforms, email marketing tools, and chatbot systems. Benefits Fully remote working arrangement. Full-time position. Flexible working hours. Working hours aligned with Central European Time (CET), or within a three-hour difference. Comprehensive onboarding and training. Structured tasks and clear feedback. Collaborative, friendly, and international team environment. Opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven organization.

jobs.title: Email Marketing Manager (Klaviyo)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Email Marketing Manager, you will oversee the execution and performance of email marketing initiatives, ensuring that campaigns are delivered efficiently and contribute to clients' business growth. Your responsibilities will include: Coordinate and monitor multiple email marketing projects, ensuring deadlines, priorities, and deliverables remain on track. Brief and collaborate with the design team to develop effective and engaging email creatives. Write persuasive, conversion-focused copy tailored to each brand's audience and objectives. Build, configure, and manage email campaigns, automated flows, and pop-ups within Klaviyo. Support customer communication initiatives across additional channels, including WhatsApp and print mailings. Use modern AI-powered tools to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflow efficiency. Monitor campaign execution and performance, identifying opportunities to improve engagement and commercial results. Take ownership of project outcomes and proactively identify solutions to operational or performance challenges. Requirements The ideal candidate combines practical Klaviyo experience with strong copywriting skills, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage several projects independently. You should be proactive, accountable, and motivated by delivering measurable results. The following qualifications are expected: At least one year of intensive, hands-on experience with Klaviyo. Proven ability to independently build and manage email campaigns, automated flows, and pop-ups. Previous copywriting experience, with the ability to create persuasive content that drives conversions. Strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Fluent written and spoken German is essential. Experience in e-commerce or a marketing agency is an advantage. Strong sense of ownership and accountability for results. A solution-oriented mindset and commitment to delivering high-quality work. Genuine interest in continuous learning and professional development. Customer-focused approach, with the motivation to go the extra mile to support client success. Benefits Annual gross salary of €45,000–€55,000. Permanent, full-time employment contract. Fully remote working arrangement, available worldwide. 40-hour working week. 20 days of annual paid leave. Direct collaboration with company founders and opportunities for accelerated learning. Clear processes, autonomy, and a high level of trust without micromanagement. Opportunities to take on greater responsibility and grow with the team over time. Long-term opportunity to contribute to the development of a growing business.

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Health Insurance
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Business Analyst, you will act as the link between business departments and IT teams, ensuring that insurance requirements are accurately understood, documented, and translated into practical solutions. Your responsibilities will include: Analyze business requirements and operational processes within the Swiss health and accident insurance sector. Develop appropriate solutions in collaboration with business stakeholders and IT specialists. Manage requirements throughout the full lifecycle, including analysis, concept development, specification, implementation, and validation. Contribute to the continuous improvement of insurance applications and business processes, particularly claims processing and automated invoice verification. Ensure the functional and technical quality of applications, supporting error analysis and resolution when needed. Configure and maintain insurance applications, including keeping reference data and tariff information accurate and up to date. Participate in customer projects and coordinate release planning and implementation with customers, business teams, developers, and system providers. Monitor legislative and regulatory developments in the Swiss insurance market and identify the resulting business and system requirements. Requirements The ideal candidate combines a solid understanding of health insurance operations with strong business analysis and requirements engineering capabilities. You should be comfortable working independently while collaborating with a range of business and technical stakeholders. The following qualifications are expected: Degree or professional training in business informatics, computer science, or a commercial discipline, supported by strong IT affinity. Several years of professional experience in the Swiss health and/or accident insurance sector. In-depth knowledge of claims processes under the Swiss Health Insurance Act (KVG) and/or Insurance Contract Act (VVG). Experience with insurance tariffs and tariff-related processes is an advantage. Proven experience in business analysis, requirements engineering, and the analysis, design, and specification of business requirements. Familiarity with insurance applications, ideally Adcubum Syrius or Sumex. Experience configuring applications; knowledge of SQL is an advantage. Knowledge of software testing, quality assurance, or release management is a plus. Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders. Excellent written and spoken German, with a professional communication style. Benefits Remote working arrangement, open to candidates worldwide. Fixed-term employment contract. Opportunity to contribute to projects within the Swiss health and accident insurance sector. Potential to work across business analysis, insurance application optimization, and IT implementation. Start as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Test Manager - Output/CCM/Document Management Systems
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Test Manager, you will take ownership of the overall testing approach and ensure that all activities are properly planned, coordinated, and executed throughout the system replacement project. Your responsibilities will include: Develop and own the test strategy and test concept for replacing the existing Customer Communication Management (CCM) platform. Define and manage legacy-versus-new system comparisons, ensuring documents are generated using identical data streams across both environments. Plan, coordinate, monitor, and control all testing activities from initial design through implementation. Work closely with the Product Owner, development teams, solution architects, and business departments to align testing objectives and priorities. Design approaches for testing documents that cannot be triggered manually, such as payment reminders and month-end processing outputs, using simulations, scheduled execution, or batch testing environments. Establish and maintain test data management processes, including use-case-based datasets such as real estate financing scenarios, while ensuring compliance with data protection requirements. Coordinate integration testing, end-to-end testing, performance and volume testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Lead defect management activities, ensuring issues are documented, prioritized, tracked, and resolved effectively. Provide transparent test progress reports to project management and steering committees. Assess implementation readiness and provide recommendations for go/no-go decisions. Requirements The ideal candidate is an experienced Test Manager with a strong background in complex system replacement or migration projects. You should combine technical testing expertise with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams and communicate effectively with business and IT stakeholders. The following qualifications are expected: Several years of experience working as a Test Manager on large-scale system replacement or migration projects. Experience in the banking sector is an advantage. Knowledge of Customer Communication Management (CCM), output management, or document management platforms. Familiarity with solutions such as OpenText Exstream, Quadient Inspire, Compart, Messagepoint, or comparable technologies. Strong understanding of software development lifecycles and agile delivery methodologies, particularly SAFe and Scrum. Proven leadership, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across business, IT, and operational teams. ISTQB Advanced Level Test Manager certification or an equivalent qualification. A clean background record, with no debt enforcement proceedings or criminal convictions. Fluent German and English communication skills. Benefits 50% part-time freelance engagement. Fully remote working arrangement, open to candidates worldwide. Potential to combine this assignment with a separate 50% Test Engineer role. Opportunity to contribute to a major CCM and document management system replacement project. Start as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Payment Operations Analyst
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Take ownership of checkout funnel health by identifying emerging issues, surfacing defects, and developing alerts and insights before they become business-critical. Lead root-cause investigations into payment funnel drop-offs and declining authorization rates, distinguishing technical issues from user behavior patterns. Analyze authorization rates, decline codes, and performance across multiple payment service providers (PSPs) to identify bottlenecks and prioritize improvements. Investigate payment performance issues, including processor outages and disruptions across different stages of the checkout journey. Develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, and alerts that provide reliable visibility into payment funnel performance. Support regular reporting to cross-functional teams, translating payment data and customer behavior insights into clear recommendations. Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Fraud teams to diagnose issues, coordinate investigations, and drive measurable improvements in authorization rates and conversion. Communicate technical findings and business impact clearly to stakeholders without specialist payments knowledge. Help establish and improve the team's diagnostic processes, contributing practical solutions and developing into a trusted point of contact for payment funnel health. Requirements: Hands-on experience working with payment funnels in a complex, multi-provider environment. Strong understanding of payment concepts and processes, including interchange, decline codes, foreign exchange (FX), tokenization, 3D Secure (3DS), and fraud fundamentals. Demonstrated experience conducting root-cause analysis of payment funnel drop-offs, authorization declines, and performance patterns, with the ability to distinguish technical causes from behavioral factors. Strong SQL skills and the ability to independently investigate payment data and identify meaningful trends. Ability to interpret complex technical findings and customer behavior insights and communicate them clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Practical understanding of payment service provider performance and the factors affecting authorization and conversion. Familiarity with self-service business intelligence (BI) or dashboarding tools is an advantage. Experience conducting comparative analysis across multiple payment service providers is beneficial. Ability to work effectively in ambiguous, fast-changing, or high-growth environments without relying on fully established processes. A proactive, independent approach to problem-solving, with the initiative to investigate issues, test ideas, and develop solutions. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with cross-functional teams. Good English communication skills are required; professional fluency is preferred. Benefits: Annual salary range of €40,000–€60,000, depending on experience and role scope. Opportunity to participate in an Employee Stock Options program. Performance-based and referral bonus opportunities. Additional paid leave and a personal learning budget through various bonus programs. Paid volunteering opportunities. Flexible work location, with options to work remotely, from an office, or while traveling. Opportunities to contribute to the growth and development of an international digital product. Professional development supported by structured feedback and promotion processes. Opportunities for accelerated personal and professional growth within an international team.

Build and improve self-service onboarding experiences, aiming to enable independent hotels to become ready for sale in under 10 minutes. Identify, evaluate, and prioritize connectivity partners and hotel distribution integrations based on customer demand, commercial opportunity, and potential inventory growth. Lead a dedicated cross-functional product squad of approximately five engineers and one designer, providing clear direction and ensuring delivery against the roadmap. Work with a high degree of ownership, making timely decisions, testing ideas, and taking responsibility for the commercial and operational impact of product outcomes. Design and deliver leadership development initiatives for first-time managers, experienced leaders, senior executives, and high-potential employees. Oversee mandatory and compliance training in collaboration with Legal and Compliance teams, ensuring consistent implementation and completion across all international locations. Manage the company's Learning Management System (LMS), digital content library, and learning technology infrastructure, combining instructor-led sessions, online courses, and practical workplace learning. Partner with Engineering, Product, and Security leadership to develop technical learning pathways covering platform architecture, blockchain and cryptocurrency fundamentals, security practices, and emerging technologies, including AI. Establish technical onboarding and certification programs that accelerate employee productivity and encourage continuous technical development. jobs.title: Senior Talent Partner (fixed-term) (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Act as a strategic HR partner and trusted advisor to leaders and employees across headquarters departments, providing guidance throughout the entire employee lifecycle. Support managers with recruitment activities, from workforce needs clarification and role definition to interview processes, candidate evaluation, and offer management. Empower hiring managers to take ownership of recruitment by implementing efficient hiring processes, improving interview skills, and providing practical guidance throughout the selection process. jobs.title: Bild-Ad Designer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Design eye-catching, conversion-focused static advertisements for Meta platforms, including Facebook and Instagram. Research target audiences and understand their purchasing motivations to translate marketing insights, psychological triggers, hooks, and advertising angles into effective visual concepts. Develop a variety of creative formats, including product-focused advertisements, UGC-style statics, before-and-after visuals, collages, and carousels. Collaborate with copywriters and creative strategists to translate briefs and advertising concepts into engaging visuals while contributing original ideas. Create new variations of successful advertisements by testing different layouts, visual hooks, messaging placements, and design approaches. Analyze performance feedback and use insights to continuously refine and optimize advertising creatives. Stay up to date with emerging design trends, social media advertising formats, and creative techniques, applying them to relevant e-commerce campaigns. Explore innovative design approaches and AI-powered tools to improve creative workflows and accelerate concept development. Candidates with an outstanding portfolio and strong creative potential are also encouraged to apply. Solid understanding of direct-response design principles, with the ability to create visuals that not only look appealing but also drive engagement, conversions, and sales. Proficiency in design software such as Adobe Photoshop, Figma, Adobe InDesign, or equivalent creative tools. Strong visual design skills, including an excellent understanding of layouts, typography, composition, and visual storytelling. Ability to develop attention-grabbing concepts, compelling visual hooks, and unconventional creative approaches that help advertisements stand out in crowded social media feeds. Good understanding of consumer behavior, marketing psychology, and the elements that influence purchasing decisions. Creative mindset, curiosity, and willingness to experiment with different visual styles, formats, and advertising concepts. Strong organizational skills, independence, reliability, and the ability to manage projects and deadlines with minimal supervision. Fast-paced execution: Bring ideas to life quickly through streamlined workflows, practical feedback, and rapid creative testing. Collaborative team environment: Join a small, flexible, and supportive team that values direct communication, creativity, humor, and shared success. Long-term opportunity: Initial contract duration of 12 months, with the possibility of building a lasting professional collaboration. Quick onboarding: Expected start as soon as possible.

Our partner is looking for a Senior Strategic Sales Manager (m/f/d) based in India. We are looking for an experienced strategic sales professional to drive business growth and develop high-value client relationships across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, and Switzerland). Working closely with technical experts, pre-sales teams, and strategic partners, you will develop tailored solutions that address customers' evolving business needs. Identify opportunities to transform individual projects into long-term service engagements, with a particular focus on managed services, recurring contracts, and sustainable revenue generation. Take full ownership of sales performance and strategic account development, ensuring achievement of revenue targets, including recurring revenue from managed services and reselling. jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: Accountabilities: Lead the technical design, development, and delivery of major AI initiatives, including AI-powered assistants, contextual data systems, and generative AI features. Contribute directly to production AI systems from the outset, identifying technical opportunities and delivering improvements to existing architecture and workflows. Drive early improvements in AI quality, reliability, and performance by addressing known failure points, strengthening evaluation coverage, and implementing measurable enhancements. Take ownership of major AI projects from architecture and technical planning through cross-functional collaboration, deployment, and ongoing optimization. Define and influence architectural decisions across engineering teams, with particular responsibility for AI architecture and shared platform infrastructure. Establish scalable AI quality frameworks, including automated evaluations, regression testing, guardrails, agent tracing, human feedback mechanisms, and production monitoring. Design and implement reliable AI agents and tool integrations, balancing deterministic code and LLM capabilities while addressing security, latency, reliability, and cost. Drive broader engineering initiatives that improve development quality and velocity, such as AI evaluation standards, agentic software development practices, code review processes, and technical documentation. Collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, Operations, and engineering stakeholders to translate business needs into effective technical solutions. Promote engineering excellence through technical mentorship, knowledge sharing, clear architectural standards, and a culture of continuous improvement. Requirements: Extensive experience in software engineering at Staff Engineer or equivalent level, with a proven ability to lead complex, ambiguous initiatives as a hands-on individual contributor. Demonstrated experience designing, building, and deploying production-grade LLM applications, AI agents, or generative AI features used by real customers. Strong technical leadership skills, including the ability to influence architectural decisions across teams, establish engineering standards, and drive initiatives from proposal through implementation. Proven experience building and maintaining AI evaluation frameworks that combine automated testing, agent traces, human feedback, and production monitoring to measure quality and prevent regressions. Strong understanding of AI agent architecture, tool design, and orchestration, including the ability to determine when deterministic logic is preferable to LLM-based solutions. Experience designing secure and reliable tool boundaries, human-in-the-loop workflows, and systems that balance performance, latency, security, and operational costs. Sound judgment in build-versus-buy decisions, model selection, and AI provider integrations. Strong backend and platform engineering expertise, particularly with Python and Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, asynchronous workers, and REST or GraphQL APIs. Ability to design scalable shared AI infrastructure with well-defined interfaces, efficient caching strategies, and robust tenant isolation. Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Design, QA, and engineering teams. A pragmatic, measurement-driven approach to AI development, prioritizing evidence, evaluation, and reliability over simply changing models or rewriting prompts. Benefits: Competitive salary package. Opportunity to build and ship production AI solutions used daily by real customers. Broad technical scope across multiple AI products and the shared infrastructure supporting them. Significant architectural influence and participation in major technical decision-making processes. Access to a valuable proprietary dataset drawn from approximately 1,200 aesthetic medical practices, supporting the development of differentiated AI capabilities. High-auton

jobs.title: Sleep Test Specialist (S1)
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As a Sleep Test Specialist, you will support patients throughout the at-home sleep testing process, ensuring they receive the guidance and follow-up needed to complete their tests efficiently. Contact patients through phone calls, emails, and SMS to provide clear instructions and guidance on completing their sleep tests. Answer patient questions, address concerns, and resolve obstacles that may prevent successful test completion. Maintain a professional, empathetic, and patient-focused approach in all communications. Proactively follow up with patients who have received their testing kits but have not yet completed their tests. Develop and implement engagement strategies to encourage timely test completion and improve patient participation. Identify reasons for delays or incomplete tests and take appropriate action to address them. Monitor patient progress and track key performance indicators related to test completion and engagement. Maintain accurate records of patient interactions, follow-ups, test statuses, and other relevant information. Identify trends and operational bottlenecks and use performance insights to improve follow-up strategies. Perform data entry, update patient records, assist with appointment scheduling, and handle other administrative responsibilities. Coordinate with clinical, marketing, and internal support teams to ensure consistent communication throughout the patient journey. Collect and share patient feedback, identify recurring challenges, and recommend improvements to the sleep testing experience. Contribute practical ideas and initiatives to improve operational efficiency and overall test completion rates. Requirements: You are a highly organized and proactive professional with strong communication skills and the ability to motivate patients while managing multiple responsibilities in a performance-driven environment. At least 2 years of experience in customer service, administrative support, patient engagement, or a related field. Previous experience in healthcare or direct-to-consumer (DTC) environments is an advantage. Bachelor's degree preferred, although relevant professional experience may be considered. Proven ability to meet or exceed performance targets in a metrics-driven environment. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills, with a preference for a high level of spoken English proficiency. Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to communicate clearly, empathetically, and persuasively. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain consistent follow-up. Proactive problem-solving abilities and the confidence to identify obstacles and take initiative. Comfortable using CRM systems, patient management platforms, and basic reporting tools. Previous experience with Salesforce is a plus. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong sense of accountability, reliability, and commitment to delivering high-quality services. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Attractive and competitive contractor rates. Weekly payments: Receive payments on a weekly basis. Fully remote opportunity: Work remotely from anywhere, with applicants welcomed across different regions. Full-time engagement: 40 contracted hours per week. Structured work schedule: Anticipated Monday-to-Friday schedule, with daily working hours to be confirmed according to client requirements and time zone availability. Free training and upskilling: Access learning opportunities to develop your professional skills. Ongoing support: Benefit from continuous guidance and assistance throughout your engagement. Supportive community: Join a vibrant professional community where contractors can connect and support one another. Additional opportunities: Access various other open positions and potential future engagements.

jobs.description: Accountabilities: As an Account Manager and B2B Growth Consultant, you will take full ownership of your client portfolio, combining strategic consulting, relationship management, and commercial development. Lead strategic workshops with clients to define target audiences, positioning, messaging, and growth objectives. Develop tailored B2B acquisition strategies aligned with each client's business model and commercial priorities. Coordinate campaign implementation with internal teams responsible for technical execution. Monitor campaign performance, analyze results, and identify actionable opportunities for continuous improvement. Conduct regular client review calls, address questions, communicate progress, and ensure agreed next steps are delivered. Proactively manage client relationships, take ownership of challenges, and maintain high levels of customer satisfaction. Identify opportunities for account expansion and recommend relevant additional services and solutions. Develop successful client relationships into case studies, referrals, and long-term business partnerships. Contribute directly to portfolio growth through retention, upselling, and measurable client outcomes. Requirements: You bring relevant B2B experience and a strong understanding of customer relationships, business development, and commercial growth. You are comfortable working with senior decision-makers and taking ownership of client outcomes. Proven experience managing direct client relationships and taking responsibility for business outcomes. Ability to communicate confidently and effectively with founders, managing directors, and sales leaders. Understanding of B2B customer acquisition, sales processes, and business development strategies. Ability to quickly understand new business models and translate commercial challenges into practical solutions. A track record of measurable achievements, supported by concrete examples of previous results. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English. jobs.title: Head of Finance - R&D
jobs.description: Accountabilities: As Head of Finance - R&D, you will lead the development and management of the financial infrastructure, treasury operations, and banking partnerships supporting international technology businesses. Your main responsibilities will include: Banking and Payment Infrastructure Design and implement a flexible, multi-jurisdictional banking network for international digital businesses operating under demanding compliance requirements. Identify, negotiate with, and onboard strategic financial partners, including leading banks, Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs), Payment Service Providers (PSPs), custodians, and financial platforms. Negotiate favorable commercial terms, including transaction fees, payment terms, foreign exchange rates, and hedging instruments. Establish backup banking relationships and alternative payment channels to ensure uninterrupted transaction processing. Treasury and Liquidity Management Manage multi-currency liquidity, working capital, cash pooling, and treasury operations across a group of legal entities. Oversee complex international transfers through SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, and other payment networks, prioritizing speed, security, and cost efficiency. Monitor and reduce treasury expenses, including FX spreads, acquiring fees, and banking charges. Compliance, KYC, and Regulatory Strategy Coordinate banking due diligence and maintain effective communication with bank compliance and risk teams. Ensure the long-term stability of banking relationships and payment flows. Support financial restructuring, corporate changes, and related banking and compliance requirements. Financial Systems and Executive Partnership Build integrated treasury and financial processes from the ground up. Partner with founders and senior leadership on unit economics, ROI analysis, and financial modeling. Recruit, lead, and develop the treasury and operational finance team. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines senior finance leadership experience with strong expertise in international treasury operations, banking infrastructure, and financial compliance. You should bring: At least 5 years of experience as a CFO, VP of Finance, or Head of Treasury in fast-growing businesses. A proven track record of opening corporate bank accounts and establishing efficient payment processes. Deep knowledge of international AML/KYC principles, cross-border compliance, and regulatory requirements across different jurisdictions. Practical experience managing multi-currency funds, foreign exchange exposure, financial settlement instruments, and transaction cost optimization. Strong negotiation skills and the ability to manage complex relationships with banks, legal advisors, and financial service providers. Advanced English proficiency (C1/C2), with the ability to lead detailed, persuasive negotiations independently. Strong strategic thinking, financial judgment, and the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment. Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with founders and executive stakeholders. Benefits: High level of autonomy: Full ownership of the financial and banking infrastructure, with minimal unnecessary bureaucracy. Meaningful business impact: Direct involvement in launching and scaling new technology businesses serving millions of users. Strong professional environment: Collaboration with experienced founders and talented engineering and marketing professionals. jobs.title: Deputy CDO
jobs.description: Accountabilities: The Deputy CDO will take ownership of execution across the Research Center, translating strategic priorities into measurable results while ensuring operational excellence, effective resource management, and strong collaboration across teams. Strategic Initiative Leadership: Lead selected strategic initiatives from business case development and prioritization through implementation and measurable business impact. Ensure projects align with organizational objectives and deliver tangible value. Executive Stakeholder Management: Collaborate directly with C-level executives and business leaders to align priorities, negotiate resources and timelines, and manage strategic trade-offs using data-driven arguments and financial insights. Cross-Functional Project Execution: Oversee major initiatives across data and analytics, including data platform development, BigQuery migration, complex machine learning projects, experimentation processes, AI-powered analytics, UX research, and data quality improvements. Project Delivery and Issue Resolution: Identify and resolve delivery bottlenecks across teams. Clarify project scope, assign ownership, establish next steps, address dependencies, and escalate risks early to ensure initiatives progress successfully. Resource and Backlog Management: Manage capacity, resources, and backlogs across multiple teams. Prioritize initiatives according to business value, coordinate dependencies between ML, backend, product, and analytics teams, and reassess or discontinue projects that fail to deliver expected results. Operational Management and Governance: Establish and maintain the operating framework for the Research Center, including monthly business reviews, quarterly planning, project reviews, retrospectives, commitment tracking, escalation procedures, and centralized performance dashboards. jobs.title: Innovation Lead
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Own and manage a defined segment of the Innovation and IP pipeline, overseeing initiatives from initial assessment and scoping through execution. Identify, evaluate, and prioritize innovation opportunities in line with strategic objectives and commercial priorities. Translate scientific research, emerging technologies, and external opportunities into compelling value propositions, business cases, and development roadmaps. Lead technology development and applied-service projects, ensuring delivery against agreed milestones, budgets, and readiness criteria. Transform early-stage concepts into structured action plans with clear objectives, deliverables, responsibilities, and decision-making milestones. Coordinate cross-functional teams, including scientific, technical, product, marketing, and commercial stakeholders, to advance projects towards market readiness. Develop and maintain relationships with universities, research institutions, technology partners, consultants, and potential licensees. Support technology transfer, co-development initiatives, licensing agreements, and intellectual property commercialisation. Monitor and communicate project progress, identifying risks, dependencies, resource requirements, and next steps to ensure effective execution. Requirements: Academic background in Life Sciences, preferably Biology or a related scientific discipline. A PhD is considered an advantage but is not mandatory. Demonstrated experience translating scientific research, technologies, or complex technical concepts into applied services, development projects, or commercial opportunities. Professional experience in innovation management, life sciences business development, technology transfer, research commercialisation, licensing, or a comparable field. Strong project management capabilities, with a proven ability to lead complex initiatives from initial concept through successful execution. Solid commercial awareness, strategic judgement, and a proactive, results-oriented mindset. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across scientific, technical, commercial, and legal teams. Ability to work independently, take ownership, make informed decisions, and drive initiatives forward. Professional fluency in English and willingness to travel regularly within Europe. Previous experience in animal nutrition, veterinary science, diagnostics, biomonitoring, university partnerships, technology licensing, or intellectual property management is a strong advantage. Benefits: Full-time position within an international and innovation-driven environment. Europe-based role with the flexibility to work remotely from home. Opportunity to take ownership of meaningful innovation and intellectual property projects. Hands-on involvement in transforming scientific discoveries into commercially viable solutions. Regular opportunities to collaborate with universities, research organisations, technology partners, and multidisciplinary teams across Europe. Professional development through exposure to scientific innovation, technology transfer, business development, and commercialisation activities. Regular European travel, offering opportunities to develop an international professional network.

jobs.title: Freelance Video Editor (M/F/D)
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Edit and produce engaging YouTube long-form videos, typically ranging from 8 to 15 minutes. Develop compelling storytelling through creative editing, effective pacing, and well-structured narratives. Enhance videos with appropriate visuals, transitions, effects, and other post-production elements to ensure a professional final result. Take ownership of assigned projects, demonstrating independent thinking and proactively suggesting creative improvements. Incorporate feedback accurately and efficiently while maintaining consistent quality standards. Continuously refine editing techniques and contribute to improving the overall quality of video content. Requirements: Previous experience in video editing, ideally with a portfolio demonstrating long-form YouTube content. Candidates with short-form editing experience and strong technical skills are also encouraged to apply, as training can be provided. Proficiency in at least one professional video editing tool, such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or equivalent software. Strong storytelling abilities, creative thinking, and a good understanding of video structure, pacing, and visual composition. Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to deliver polished, well-organized, and engaging content. Reliability, accountability, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. Strong communication and organizational skills, including the ability to meet deadlines, manage priorities, and implement feedback effectively. A proactive mindset and willingness to learn, grow, and continuously improve creative output. Benefits: Competitive monthly compensation ranging from €1,500 to €4,000 , with additional performance-based earning potential. Long-term freelance collaboration rather than short-term project assignments. Fully remote working arrangements, offering flexibility regarding location. Structured professional workflows designed to minimize unnecessary revisions and streamline collaboration. Access to training, coaching, and ongoing professional development. Direct, constructive feedback and fast communication within a collaborative environment. Flat hierarchies and opportunities to contribute ideas and take ownership of projects. Career development opportunities, including potential progression toward Senior Editor or Creative Lead positions.

jobs.title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Act as the primary onboarding contact for new business partners, explaining onboarding requirements, answering questions, and providing clear guidance throughout the entire process. Collect business information, Know Your Customer (KYC) documentation, ownership details, and other required materials in accordance with internal procedures and compliance standards. Review submitted documents and information to ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency, proactively following up on missing documents, discrepancies, or additional requirements. Enter and maintain partner information and documentation within the appropriate CRM platforms and internal systems, ensuring records remain accurate and up to date. Collaborate with the Compliance team to coordinate document reviews, respond to additional information requests, manage escalations, and follow each case through to final approval. Monitor the progress of individual onboarding cases, identify potential delays, resolve issues proactively, and keep business partners and internal stakeholders informed. Work closely with Sales, Operations, and Host Success teams to ensure a seamless transition from initial onboarding to ongoing partner support. Handle confidential business and personal information responsibly, following established privacy, data protection, and information security procedures. Identify recurring onboarding challenges and recommend improvements to communication templates, workflows, documentation requirements, and operational processes. Track onboarding activity, completion timelines, outstanding documentation, and case progress to support operational efficiency and reporting. Use digital and AI-powered tools where appropriate to support research, streamline administrative tasks, and improve daily productivity. Requirements: At least 1 year of professional experience in customer onboarding, customer support, account coordination, operations, or a related customer-facing or administrative role. Strong attention to detail, with practical experience reviewing documents, validating customer information, and maintaining accurate records. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain processes and documentation requirements clearly to business owners and other stakeholders. Strong organisational and follow-up abilities, including the capacity to manage multiple onboarding cases, prioritise tasks, and consistently meet deadlines. Familiarity with CRM platforms, document management systems, Microsoft Office, and other standard business productivity tools. Good judgement when handling sensitive and confidential information, with an understanding of when to escalate discrepancies or potential compliance concerns. High levels of self-motivation, accountability, and independence, with the ability to remain productive and organised in a fully remote working environment. Customer-oriented mindset, strong interpersonal skills, and a proactive approach to resolving issues and improving the onboarding experience. Comfort using AI-powered tools to support research, information processing, and everyday productivity is a strong advantage. Previous experience with Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures, business verification, or customer due diligence is considered a plus. Experience supporting business customers within financial services, fintech, payment solutions, or cryptocurrency environments is an additional advantage. Familiarity with business registration documents, company ownership structures, and related verification requirements is beneficial. Candidates must currently reside in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe to be eligible for this fully remote opportunity. Benefits: Competitive USD Salary: Attractive compensation paid consistently every month, regardless of your location. Performance-Based Incentives: Additional financial rewards recognising individual achievements and the quality of your work. Paid Annual Leave: 10 days o

jobs.title: Customer Retention Supervisor
jobs.description: Accountabilities:: Lead, supervise, and motivate a team of Customer Retention Specialists, establishing clear performance objectives, responsibilities, and accountability standards. Conduct outbound customer calls personally to encourage repeat transactions, reconnect with inactive customers, and demonstrate effective retention techniques by example. Develop, implement, and continuously improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), calling workflows, scripts, and training materials to strengthen team performance. Organise daily outreach activities, manage agent schedules, and allocate campaign assignments to ensure efficient customer engagement. Design and execute customer retention campaigns, including promotional offers, discount incentives, abandoned transaction follow-ups, and reactivation initiatives. Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs), including call volumes, conversion rates, repeat transactions, customer reactivation rates, and revenue recovered. Conduct regular call evaluations, performance reviews, and individual coaching sessions to identify improvement opportunities and strengthen agents' communication and sales skills. Analyse customer behaviour, transaction activity, and campaign performance to identify retention opportunities and develop targeted engagement strategies. Maintain accurate customer relationship management (CRM) records, agent scorecards, performance dashboards, and regular operational reports. Manage escalated customer concerns and collaborate with Marketing, Customer Support, Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure effective issue resolution. Support recruitment, onboarding, and training initiatives to build and maintain a capable, results-oriented retention team. Use relevant digital and AI-powered tools to improve research, script development, workflow efficiency, and overall team productivity. Requirements: At least 3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in customer retention, outbound sales, contact centre operations, or a similar customer-facing environment. Demonstrated success in customer conversion, retention, and reactivation, with experience managing performance-driven teams and achieving measurable commercial results. Proven ability to develop and implement SOPs, outbound calling scripts, operational workflows, and employee training materials. Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with the ability to motivate teams, manage performance, and encourage continuous improvement. Excellent communication, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, particularly when engaging customers over the phone. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable improvement plans. Ability to balance direct customer engagement with team supervision and operational responsibilities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, alongside practical experience using CRM systems and outbound calling platforms. Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support research, improve customer communication scripts, and enhance everyday productivity. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service and performance standards. Previous experience in fintech, financial services, cryptocurrency, or another regulated industry is a significant advantage. Basic understanding of cryptocurrency and blockchain technologies, combined with a genuine interest in financial technology, is considered a plus. Benefits: Competitive USD Salary: Attractive compensation paid consistently every month, regardless of your location.
